name: Anantara Santorini Abu Dhabi Retreat
review_text:
I visited Anantara Santorini Abu Dhabi Retreat for a day pass experience priced at AED 800, with AED 400 redeemable on food and drinks. The ambiance was excellent, and the hotel’s Santorini-inspired design creates a truly serene and picturesque atmosphere. The infinity pool was stunning, and the service was top-notch—attentive and professional throughout.

However, the food didn’t meet my expectations, especially considering the premium pricing. For instance, the lobster roll was AED 195 but fell far short of what I’d expect for that price. Additionally, some items felt unnecessarily expensive—AED 100 for a glass of wine is hard to justify. While I understand this is a luxury destination, the food experience didn’t deliver the pleasure I anticipated.

That said, the hotel does an excellent job of creating a sense of disconnection from the outside world, and the adults-only policy adds to the tranquil vibe. It’s a wonderful spot to relax, but I hope to see improvements in the food quality to match the high standards of the property.

Would I visit again? Possibly, but I’d be cautious about the dining choices next time.

review_text:
Отдыхали в отеле Anantara Santorini с 29.11.25 по 04.12.25. Отель просто превосходный: недавно открылся, всего 22 номера в отеле, прекрасный сервис, вас сопровождает менеджер, очень красивые стильные номера, уединенное место на берегу моря. Нам сделали замену номера на более высокий уровень-без доплат, номер большой, с террасой и отдельным выходом к морю. В отеле отменная еда: завтрак включен - холодные закуски по системе шведский стол, горячий завтрак заказываешь по меню. Обедали, ужинали в ресторанах отеля, их два, еда превосходная, особенно на обед - рыба, курица, ягненок, все очень вкусно и огромные порции. Цена примерно 140-190 дирхамм. Иногда брали 1 блюдо на двоих, одному просто не съесть. Отдельное спасибо за сопровождение и внимание нашему менеджеру  Jasurbek, владеет английским, русским языками, очень внимательный, приятный.
We stayed at the Anantara Santorini from November 29, 2025, to December 4, 2025. The hotel is simply superb: newly opened, with only 22 rooms, excellent service, a dedicated manager, beautiful, stylish rooms, and a secluded location on the seashore. We were upgraded to a higher standard at no extra charge; the room is large, with a terrace and private access to the sea. The hotel food is excellent: breakfast is included—cold appetizers are served buffet-style, and hot breakfast is ordered à la carte. We had lunch and dinner at the hotel's two restaurants, and the food was excellent, especially lunch—fish, chicken, and lamb—everything was delicious and the portions were huge. Prices ranged from 140-190 dirhams. Sometimes we shared a dish; it was simply too much for one person to finish. Special thanks to our manager, Jasurbek, for his assistance and attention; he speaks English and Russian and is very attentive and pleasant.

name: Anantara Santorini Abu Dhabi Retreat
review_text: This was our second stay at Anantara Santorini and once again it proved to be one of our absolute favourite hotels we have ever visited. I might be a little biased because we already loved it the first time, but the experience truly impressed us again. :)||The breakfast remains one of our favourites, this time offering a lovely combination of à-la-carte dishes and a cold buffet selection. We enjoyed it a lot every single morning, especially the fresh juices and smoothies. A very special thank you goes to Rose, who welcomed us each day with so much warmth and positivity. She made every morning feel special.||Our room had a beautiful sea view and was very spacious. The pool area was always quiet and relaxing and every day we received small surprises such as a special drink and fresh coconut, which we appreciated a lot. The beach was very clean and peaceful.||In the evenings, we usually chose in-room dining on our terrace, as the restaurant offering did not fully match our preferences. The food and service were always very good and enjoying dinner on the terrace made it a wonderful experience. Every evening there is also a movie screening in the cinema which we also enjoyed.||A big thank you goes to Ayub, who took great care of us throughout our entire stay. His support made everything smooth and enjoyable, and we always felt very well looked after.||The overall atmosphere of the resort is incredibly calming and intimate, with stunning sea views and a beautiful boutique-style design. It is truly a place where you can unwind completely and enjoy peaceful moments.||All in all, it was another memorable and relaxing stay at one of the most beautiful and serene retreats in the UAE. We would return without hesitation.

Our stay at Anantara Santorini Abu Dhabi was truly magical and unforgettable! We came to celebrate my husband’s birthday, and it turned out to be one of the most memorable experiences we’ve ever had.

The ambiance of the hotel is pure tranquility. Listening to the gentle sound of the waves mixed with soothing background music instantly made us forget the hustle and bustle of daily life. It was peaceful, calming, and exactly what we needed.
You must try their spa — it’s absolute heaven! Therene and KC gave us deeply relaxing, personalized treatments that left us completely rejuvenated. Their professionalism and genuine care made the experience even more special.
Our dinner at Thalassa was equally wonderful — delicious food, excellent service from Ahmed, and a team that truly goes above and beyond.

I recently had the pleasure of visiting the Annex Lounge at Edition Hotel Abu Dhabi, and I must say, it was an absolutely amazing experience. From the moment I stepped through the doors, I was enchanted by the cozy and classy atmosphere that exuded elegance and comfort.

The first thing that stood out to me was the incredible vibes that filled the air. The lounge had a fantastic energy, making it the perfect place to unwind and enjoy a memorable evening. The music played by the talented Dj and live singer was nothing short of perfect. The diverse playlist catered to different tastes and moods, delivering a seamless blend of upbeat tunes and laid-back melodies. It truly added to the lively ambiance of the lounge.

The Annex Lounge boasts a super fancy setting, which only added to the overall experience. The stylish decor and chic furniture created an ambiance that was both sophisticated and welcoming. Every aspect of the lounge oozed class and attention to detail.

The staff at Annex Lounge deserve a special mention for their exceptional service. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted warmly and made to feel like a valued guest. The staff members were attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to ensure that my experience was nothing short of extraordinary.

As I reflect upon my time at the Annex Lounge, I can confidently say that it surpassed all of my expectations. It's undoubtedly a place that I would recommend to anyone seeking a memorable and enjoyable evening. Whether you're looking to celebrate a special occasion or simply unwind after a long day, Annex Lounge is the perfect destination.

In conclusion, if you're in Abu Dhabi and craving a cozy, classy, and vibrant experience, make sure to visit the Annex Lounge at Edition Hotel. With its great vibes, perfect music, super fancy ambiance, and lovely staff, your time there is guaranteed to be exceptional. I know I will definitely be returning for more unforgettable moments.

name: ANNEX
review_text:
We had our company’s Christmas Party / Year-End Party in the ANNEX at the roof top last December 10, 2021. We availed a 3-hour package (5:30PM - 8:00PM) for food and drinks. Non Alcoholic package for AED 288 per person and Alcholic package for AED 295 per person. As per our organizer, we were promised that the food and drinks will be continuously served for 3 hours.

The venue was beautiful. The ambiance was great and the setting was picturesque as you have the view of the Al Bateen Marina.

The music was terrible. It’s not a music that you can dance to. We requested if the music can be changed but to no avail.

Some of the food tasted good but the serving was not enough. The maximum number of people per table was 10 people. For example: they only served 1 bowl of nachos for 10 people which was not enough. We asked them if we could get some more and they said that we will get it again as the menu is on rotation.

The serving time for food and drinks was very disappointing. They would serve food for maximum of 1 hour and it was just a 3-hour package. It was hard to order drinks as well as the waiters seem to be busy or not around. A lot of us were complaining that they were hungry from the long wait to be served with food.

There were a couple of security men and waiters that were rude and seem to be unbothered by our concerns and disappointments.

The last order for drinks was at 8PM and we were told that it can only be one drink per person. Which was ridiculous!

By the time it was 8:30PM we were told that we have to leave immediately as our time is over and that there was another group of people coming. Some of us weren’t even finish with our drinks and food yet.

I thought that the amount that we paid was not worth of the amount of food and service that we got. As much as we enjoyed each other’s company, the experience and service that we got was not up to par.

name: ANNEX
review_text: It was a work Christmas Party booked at night last December 10, 2021 with package of 10 food presented (appetizers and mains). Paid for 3 hours to free flow drinks. Having the drink was not a problem and it was the good thing happened. Though the most disappointing part was the SLOW food service and even the expectation of having a taste of ALL the food being offered and paid was NOT being delivered. I have tasted 4 out of 10 and it was even being shared on the table not even served individually. The expectation of EVEN having a taste of the at least majority of the appetizing food was NOT accomplished. Paying 295aed was not only looking for drinks/alcohol but also a least a satisfying food service. I hope services will get better. Place was intimate and clean, lovely personnel sofia, perez and chris but it was Just Unsatisfactory FOOD service for the amount I paid for it.

name: The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi
review_text:
The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi rozhodně stojí za návštěvu. Akvária mám projitá po celém světě – v Evropě, Americe i Asii – a tohle bez váhání řadím mezi ta úplně nejlepší.
Akvárium je rozděleno do deseti tematických zón, které na sebe plynule navazují. Vše je perfektně čisté, moderní, vizuálně velmi dobře řešené a zároveň přehledné i pro rodiny s dětmi. Je vidět, že jde o nové a velmi dobře udržované místo.
Mezi největší taháky patří kapustňák, arapajma gigas a hlavně velký podvodní tunel, kde se nad vámi pohybují žraloci, včetně kladivounů. Celé to působí velmi přirozeně, expozice nejsou přeplácané a zvířata jsou dobře viditelná. Zážitek je silný jak pro děti, tak pro dospělé.
Menší, ale praktická kritická poznámka:
během celé prohlídkové trasy je minimum toalet. Jedna větší možnost je až před hlavním tunelem. Pokud jdete s dětmi, určitě doporučuji využít toalety hned na začátku, jinak vás čeká nepříjemné vracení se zpět po trase.
Vstupné je podle mého názoru přiměřené kvalitě i délce návštěvy. Lístky jsme kupovali přímo na místě a nebyl s tím žádný problém. Akvárium je plně klimatizované, což je v Abu Dhabi velké plus, zejména v teplejších měsících.
Doprava je velmi jednoduchá – Uber je v Abu Dhabi spolehlivý, dostupný a cenově rozumný, z centra města naprosto bez problému.
Velkou výhodou je i samotná lokalita. V bezprostředním okolí je krásná promenáda plná restaurací a kaváren a hned na stejné ulici se nachází velké zábavní centrum se spoustou atrakcí pro děti i dospělé. Pokud tedy plánujete program mimo samotné centrum Abu Dhabi, dá se zde bez problému strávit celý den – my jsme to tak měli, včetně oběda, procházky po promenádě a posezení v kavárnách.
Shrnuto:
moderní, špičkově udělané akvárium světové úrovně, které funguje nejen jako samostatná atrakce, ale i jako ideální základna pro celodenní program s rodinou. Jednoznačně doporučuji.

name: The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi
review_text:
The National Aquarium is the largest aquarium in the Middle East, located in the Al Qana development in Abu Dhabi. It is home to over 46,000 animals from more than 300 unique species across 10 themed zones, ranging from the UAE’s marine treasures to the frozen Arctic and the Red Sea Wreck.

Notable features include the region's longest underwater tunnel and a focus on marine conservation and education. Visitors can enjoy interactive experiences like glass-bottom boat tours, a glass bridge walk, and animal encounters with sharks, rays, and puffins. It stands as a major family attraction dedicated to exploring and preserving the marine environment.

name: The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Our visit to The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi was truly exceptional. The entire experience was educational, engaging, and perfectly designed for families. The exhibits are beautifully arranged, the environment is clean and well-organized, and the variety of marine life is simply impressive. It’s a place where children learn while having fun, and adults enjoy every moment just as much.

I would also like to extend special thanks and appreciation to Ms. Hanan, one of the staff members who made our visit unforgettable. She took the time to give my children a detailed explanation about how animals are examined, cared for, rehabilitated, and eventually released back into Abu Dhabi’s natural environment. Her passion, knowledge, and kindness truly stood out. She made the experience more meaningful and inspired my children to appreciate wildlife conservation.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Abu Dhabi—an amazing place with amazing people behind it.

review_text:
تجربة مذهلة في ناشونال أكواريوم أبوظبي!
المكان مُصمّم بشكل احترافي يأخذ الزائر في رحلة بحرية فريدة عبر عالم الكائنات المائية. التنوع الكبير في الأحياء البحرية ملفت جدًا، من الأسماك الاستوائية إلى الحيوانات النادرة، وكل منطقة مصممة بعناية لتجعل التجربة غنية وممتعة.

الممرات واسعة ومنظمة، والعروض التعليمية داخل الأكواريوم تضيف قيمة كبيرة للزيارة، خاصة الشرح حول الحياة البحرية وجهود المحافظة على البيئة. طريقة عرض الكائنات رائعة، والزجاجات الضخمة تمنحك رؤية واضحة وقريبة تشعرك وكأنك داخل المحيط.

الخدمة ممتازة والموظفون لطفاء ويقدمون معلومات مفيدة للزوار، خاصة للأطفال، مما يجعل التجربة تعليمية وترفيهية في الوقت نفسه. مستوى النظافة والتنظيم عالي جدًا، والأسعار مناسبة مقارنة بحجم المعرض وتجربة الزائر.

منطقة الأنشطة الخارجية مثل ركوب القوارب الزجاجية أو تجربة المشي فوق الجسر المعلق تضيف بعدًا إضافيًا للتجربة وتستحق التجربة.

بشكل عام، يعتبر ناشونال أكواريوم من أفضل الوجهات العائلية في أبوظبي لمن يرغب في قضاء وقت ممتع ومليء بالإبهار والمعرفة. أنصح بزيارته بقوة

name: Art Central
review_text:
offers a great range of art supplies, from sketchbooks and paints to canvases and specialty materials. The store is beautifully organized, making it easy to browse and find exactly what you need. There is also an art studio for those wishing to learn.

The staff are knowledgeable, friendly, and always ready to help you choose the right tools for your projects. It’s a great spot for students, hobby artists, and professionals. Convenient location inside Boutik Mall, with parking available and other shops nearby.

A must-visit if you're looking for quality art supplies on Reem Island.

name: Art Central
review_text:
This place is honestly my favorite ever! If you love pottery or anything art related, you’ll fall in love with it. It’s super organized and has everything you can imagine from clay, glazes, and tools to other art supplies too.

The studio inside is sooo nice and peaceful. It’s clean, cozy, and just has the perfect creative vibe.

And honestly, the staff is a big part of why I love this place so much. They’re always welcoming and really make you feel comfortable to ask anything. Even if I ask a lot of questions, they never get annoyed they explain everything so clearly and kindly. You can tell they actually know what they’re talking about and they genuinely want to help. Whether it’s advice about firing, glazing, or choosing the right materials, They’re patient, professional, and super friendly

It’s honestly the perfect place for any Artist whether you’re just starting or already deep into it.

name: Art Central
review_text: What am amazing experience! It was our first time to try pottery making.  The place was rather easy to find. Located in Shams. We were sceptical about getting a slab of clay and working our way through it like dough but turns out I think id prefer to do this than the turn table but they have both options plus many more and I'm eager to try them out slowly over time.  We spent roughly two hours from rolling the slab of clay to painting and adding finishing touches.  Final product in two weeks after they fire / glaze them in the oven.  Can't wait to be back again.

Was an absolute highlight of our Abu Dhabi trip! As a classic car lover, I was blown away by the sheer scale and variety of the collection here at the Emirates National Auto Museum (متحف الإمارات الوطني للسيارات). We're talking hundreds of pristine vintage beauties—from Rolls-Royces and Bentleys to rare diplomatic gifts like the one-of-a-kind cars from world leaders—plus an impressive lineup of military vehicles and even a fighter jet (though sadly, it's not climbable). The indoor AC was a lifesaver in the lingering autumn heat, and the layout makes it easy to wander and snap photos without crowds.
It's a bit of a drive from the city (about 45 minutes out towards Liwa), but totally worth the 55 AED entry fee. Pro tip: Go in the morning to beat any potential afternoon warmth, and wear comfy shoes for the vast space. If you're into automotive history or just love shiny chrome, this private collection feels like stepping into a time machine. Highly recommend—can't wait to return with more gearhead friends! 🚗✨

name: Emirates National Auto Museum
review_text:
Rating: ★★★★☆ (4.0/5)

A truly unique automotive experience nestled in the desert sands of Al Dhafra, the Emirates National Auto Museum is a testament to one man's passion for vehicles.  Housing over 200 cars from the personal collection of His Highness Sheikh Hamad Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan, this pyramid-shaped museum offers visitors a glimpse into an eclectic array of automobiles, from classic American muscle cars to custom-built off-roaders.

Highlights:

Diverse Collection: The museum boasts a wide range of vehicles, including the Sheikh's famous "Rainbow Collection" of Mercedes-Benz cars, each painted in a different hue.

Record-Breaking Exhibits: Marvel at the world's largest motorized model car—a 4:1 scale replica of a Willys Jeep—and the massive Dodge Power Wagon, both of which are fully functional.

Photogenic Exterior: Before even entering, visitors are greeted by a retired passenger jet and the iconic globe-shaped mobile home, offering ample photo opportunities.

Considerations:

Remote Location: Situated approximately 45 kilometers south of Abu Dhabi city, reaching the museum requires a bit of a drive through the desert.

Limited Amenities: The museum lacks on-site dining options, so it's advisable to bring your own refreshments.

Maintenance: Some vehicles show signs of wear, and additional informational placards could enhance the visitor experience.

Visitor Tips:

Operating Hours: Open daily from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Admission: Entry fee is AED 50, with free admission for children under 10.

Best Time to Visit: To avoid the midday heat, consider visiting in the morning or late afternoon.

Final Thoughts: The Emirates National Auto Museum offers a fascinating journey through automotive history and innovation.  While it may not have the polish of more conventional museums, its unique exhibits and the sheer passion behind the collection make it a must-visit for car enthusiasts and curious travelers alike.

My husband and I visited the museum early on a weekend morning, around 10 AM. We paid for both of us at the entrance (I don’t recall the exact amount), and since there were no other visitors at that time, we were able to park close to the museum building.

We visited in April, and it was already quite warm—so I highly recommend bringing a bottle of water with you. The museum itself is spacious, with a fascinating collection of unique and antique cars. Be prepared to walk a lot to explore everything!

Even in the morning, it felt a bit hot inside. I believe the air conditioning system is a bit outdated and doesn’t cool the space very well, which made the visit a bit uncomfortable at times.

That said, I really enjoyed the overall experience. While it might not be the kind of place you’d return to multiple times, it’s definitely worth a visit if you’re interested in automotive history or just want to see something different. I’d recommend it for car enthusiasts and curious minds alike.

Extremely disappointing and unprofessional experience.

I was denied entry solely because I did not have my physical passport with me, despite the fact that I was coming abroad, properly dressed, and accompanied by friends who were all allowed in without any issue. I was the only one singled out — none of my friends were asked for the same requirement.

What makes this even more unacceptable is that I did have a digital copy of my ID, which was explicitly refused, with the explanation that digital IDs are only accepted for UAE holders. This is not only inconsistent, but clearly discriminatory.

The door staff, Mariam, enforced this selectively and without professionalism or basic courtesy. If this is truly a policy, it should be applied equally to everyone, not based on nationality or personal judgment.

For a venue that presents itself as welcoming, this behavior is outdated, biased, and embarrassing. Hospitality should never involve singling out or humiliating guests.

Plenty of places manage entry policies with fairness and respect. Unfortunately, this one did not.

I visited Central in Yas Bay during the 54th Eid Al Ittihad celebrations, and it was truly one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in Abu Dhabi. The restaurant has an incredible front-row view of the Yas Bay fireworks — genuinely the perfect spot to enjoy the show without any obstruction. The atmosphere was festive, vibrant, and beautifully managed despite the huge crowds that night.

A special shout-out goes to the manager, Tobi (I believe that’s the correct spelling). His professionalism, warmth, and attention to detail elevated the entire experience. He checked on every table personally, made sure we were comfortable, and even helped us get the best view right on time for the fireworks. You rarely find hospitality like this anymore — he made us feel genuinely welcomed and well taken care of.

The service was smooth, the food was great, and the vibe was unmatched. If you’re looking for a place to enjoy Yas Bay views, great food, and top-tier service, Central is 100% worth it. I’ll definitely be coming back!

name: Studio CLAY
review_text:
I want to share my honest feedback about the workshop. The wheel-throwing instructor was incredibly sweet, patient, and truly helpful. She taught us really well, and I appreciated her effort with everyone. The only challenge was that she was alone with a group of six, so it became difficult for her to support all of us at the same time. Maybe having an additional instructor for bigger groups would make the experience even smoother.

For the coloring part, the ladies were helpful, but since it was my first time, I think a clearer explanation of all the painting rules before starting would really help beginners. For example, I only learned later that the sponge can be used to erase mistakes, and not everyone was told about the coating step. A short briefing before we begin would prevent small mistakes and make the process easier for everyone.

Overall, it was a lovely experience, and everyone was kind. My only suggestion is to have more staff available during busy sessions and to give a quick full rundown of the painting rules at the start to help first-timers feel more confident.

I recently visited a pottery shop in my area, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.
The shop itself was beautifully designed, with a wide variety of pottery pieces on display. The selection was impressive, ranging from functional kitchenware to stunning decorative pieces. It was clear that a lot of thought and care went into curating the collection.
The staff at the pottery shop were knowledgeable and passionate about their craft. They were more than happy to answer any questions I had and provide recommendations based on my preferences. Their expertise made my experience enjoyable and informative.
The quality of the pottery pieces was exceptional. Each piece was meticulously crafted, showcasing the skill and artistry of the artisans. I was particularly impressed with the attention to detail and the unique designs available. It was evident that a lot of care went into creating each piece.
Not only was the pottery beautiful, but the prices were also reasonable. I felt that I was getting great value for the quality and craftsmanship of the pieces. It's rare to find such high-quality pottery at such affordable prices.
Overall, my visit to the pottery shop was a delight. The combination of a welcoming atmosphere, knowledgeable staff, and exquisite pottery made it a memorable experience. I highly recommend visiting this pottery shop for anyone looking to add some beauty and artistry to their home.
I will definitely be returning to this pottery shop in the future. Thank you for providing such a positive and enjoyable training experience!

name: Cultural Foundation Abu Dhabi
review_text:
The Cultural Foundation is a beautiful space in the heart of Abu Dhabi, offering exhibitions, workshops, and family-friendly activities. I visited during a Malaysian art show and was impressed by both the quality of the work and how open and peaceful the space felt.

It’s great for kids, with a dedicated Children’s Art Centre, and you can also join art workshops with professional artists for around 100 AED. Some exhibitions and workshops are free to drop into, so it’s worth checking their app for what’s on.

A perfect spot for a creative afternoon, whether solo or with family.

name: Cultural Foundation Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Qasr Al Hosn & Cultural Foundation: A Journey Through Time and Creativity ✨

Qasr Al Hosn is one of Abu Dhabi’s most iconic cultural landmarks, standing as a testament to the emirate’s rich history. Originally built as a watchtower in the 18th century, it later evolved into a fortress and the residence of the ruling Al Nahyan family. Today, it is a beautifully restored museum that narrates Abu Dhabi’s transformation from a small fishing village to a global metropolis.👍

⭐️Adjacent to Qasr Al Hosn is the Cultural Foundation, a hub for artistic expression and learning. The foundation offers a variety of workshops and exhibitions that celebrate art in its many forms. Visitors can participate in oil painting, acrylic and watercolor classes, painting on silk, sculpture, ceramics, photography, jewelry-making, sewing, and Arabic calligraphy. These workshops cater to both beginners and seasoned artists, making it a perfect place for anyone looking to explore their creativity.

📚The Study Lounge provides a peaceful environment for reading, research, and self-improvement, while the Theatre and Music programs bring performances that range from traditional Arabic shows to contemporary international productions. The venue itself is a masterpiece of modern architecture blended with Emirati heritage, offering an inspiring setting for learning and cultural appreciation. Convenient parking ensures an easy visit for all guests.

Another Cultural Gem: House of Artisans 🎨

For those interested in exploring the traditional crafts of the UAE, the House of Artisans is a must-visit destination. Located near Qasr Al Hosn, this cultural center is dedicated to preserving and promoting Emirati craftsmanship.

The House of Artisans is not just a place to observe but also to engage with skilled artisans who keep these traditions alive. The experience offers a deeper appreciation of the UAE’s cultural heritage while providing an opportunity to create unique handmade souvenirs.

With its interactive experiences and rich storytelling, the House of Artisans is an excellent complement to a visit to Qasr Al Hosn, making for a well-rounded cultural journey through Abu Dhabi’s past and present.

name: ERTH Hotel
review_text:
Maybe I’m nostalgic, but I remember coming here as a child and have beautiful memories when it was the Officers club. I love how they kept the original building but updated the rooms and kept a modern Emirati feel to it. One of the very few hotels to actually understand and incorporate Emirati culture and tradition well.

I’ve been here many times with kids and without. My kids love the pool and beach during summer and it’s accessible by car to the rest of Abu Dhabi, Saadiyat and Yas.
The rooms are small but well appointed, service is exceptional and goes above and beyond. The bathrooms have started showing some wear and tear over the years, especially in the smaller rooms but the suites are still alright.

This is an old building in the shape of a crescent, so the 2 lifts are in the centre of the crescent and there are none on the ends.
Some rooms are on the ground level and it gets noisy from people (kids) passing outside. Avoid ground level rooms and any rooms far from the lifts.

My only issue here is the breakfast area. Breakfast is always in Al Rimal, which is located in another building and is such a hassle to walk to, that it gets annoying especially if you’re on the top floor away from the lifts. I don’t understand why the breakfast can’t be in the same hotel building instead of the cafe on the ground level or in the restaurant facing the beach. Other than that the breakfast buffet food is always plentiful with amazing Emirati dishes as well as international options. Try the Chammi with plum or dates.

name: ERTH Hotel
review_text:
I have not even checked in yet, but I already feel compelled to share this experience. Thank you sincerely for taking care of all my requests and for the genuine kindness shown so far.

A special thank you to Mr. Abdelrahman at the front desk. From the very first interaction, he gave me a reassuring and welcoming impression. His professionalism, calm attitude, and warm manners immediately made me feel that everything is in good hands.

I am genuinely optimistic about my stay, and that is entirely thanks to this positive first impression.

name: ERTH Hotel
review_text: Loved it

name: ERTH Hotel
review_text:
Нам, выбравшим отель для отдыха возле моря и расслабления, неоднократно мешало поведение гостей сборной спортсменов Эмиратов. Не очень приятно выйти в ресторан на ужин в вечернем платье, когда возле тебя сидят громкие люди в спортивных одеждах и тапочках.
Хотелось бы видеть падобающих пятизвёздочному отелю гостей!
Живая романтическая музыка за ужином и бар, где можно посидеть после ужина с коктейлем тоже не помешают отелю.
Особенно хочется отметить единственного профессионально обслуживающего работника ресторана , невероятно приветливого человека по имени Baher!
Действительно профессионал в своём деле в стрессовых ситуациях!
Его знание разных языков помогло многим гостям отеля, которые каждый день выражали ему свою благодарность!
В целом кухня отеля была на высшем уровне,  особенно в выходной день
Воскресенье, в которое мы попробовали не только вкуснейшие блюда, а также десерты на уровне "мишелин".
Фотографии этого вечера уже давно курсируют в инстаграмме с большим успехом)).
Номера не отличаются особенным изыском, звукоизоляция желает лучшего. Функция минибара как холодильника   отсутствует!
Пляж спокойный, места есть всегда.
Но возле бассейна так же мешали гости, приехавшие отмечать детские дни рождения.
Территория отеля очень большая, для таких мероприятий всегда найдётся место в другом углу.
Ходить в купальнике между людей в нарядных платьях- обсолютно не продуманный вариант менеджеров отеля!
Не плохой отель, недостатки которого можно при желании легко устранить.

review_text:
Experienced Etihad Arena while working with the SolanaFloor team during Solana Breakpoint 2025. We weren’t part of the main event crew, but had our own glass booth at the back where we ran live streams for three days with multiple speakers.
Spending long hours inside the arena really shows how well the space is built. It’s big, but doesn’t feel chaotic. Sound was clear across the venue, which is super important when you’re doing live talks and streams. The screens, lighting, and overall setup made it easy to run content smoothly without technical friction.
From a media and streaming perspective, the venue handled scale really well. Crowd movement was mostly smooth, and even with everything happening at once, things stayed organised. Staff and security were helpful and easy to work with, which always matters during live production.
The arena stayed clean throughout the event, even during peak hours. Facilities were solid and easy to access. Overall, Etihad Arena felt reliable, modern, and built for large global events.
Covering Solana Breakpoint from here was a great experience for us at SolanaFloor. Definitely a venue that supports high-quality events and media work.

name: Etihad Arena
review_text: Enjoyed the Arijit singh concert in etihad arena. EXHILARATING EXPERIENCE 😊💗

name: Etihad Arena
review_text:
Last evening’s Arijit Singh concert at Etihad Arena, Abu Dhabi was nothing short of epic. From the very first note to the final encore, it was a musical journey that showcased why Arijit Singh is regarded as one of the finest vocalists of our time.
What stood out most was his vocal mastery and stamina. Singing continuously for nearly five hours, he remained flawless throughout—never once sounding strained or shaky. His control over his voice is truly unmatched, and every song was delivered with depth, emotion, and precision.
Equally impressive was the orchestra. Their coordination with Arijit was seamless, elevating every performance. The synergy between the musicians and the singer created an immersive experience that held the audience spellbound.
Arijit Singh’s humility deserves special mention. Despite being a global icon, he remained grounded and gracious throughout the evening. He patiently acknowledged requests and warmly interacted with guests, making a sincere effort to ensure that everyone felt included and valued before the concert concluded. This generosity of spirit is rare and speaks volumes about his character.
So captivating was the performance that at one point, I genuinely thought the concert had concluded and briefly stepped out—only to hear him begin “Sapphire.” I immediately rushed back in and stayed for yet another hour, completely mesmerized once again.
As for the venue, Etihad Arena continues to be an impressive space for large-scale events. That said, some logistical aspects could perhaps be smoother. There were noticeable queues for food, beverages, and washrooms, and the parking rerouting required a fair amount of patience. These are understandable challenges during high-capacity events, and with such overwhelming attendance, they are areas that could be further optimized in the future.
In the end, words fall short when describing Arijit Singh’s performance. No matter how much praise is given, it still feels insufficient. It was a perfect evening, marked by extraordinary music, heartfelt performances, and an artist whose talent is matched only by his humility.
A truly unforgettable concert. 🎶

Wir konnten dabei sein, als einem Falken die Krallen und der Schnabel behandelt wurde und für die bevorstehende Jagdsaison untersucht wurde. Ein trainierter Falke durtfe von allen gehalten werden und von einem Besucher gefüttert werden. Danach besuchten wir noch verschiedene Volieren mit Eulen etc sowie ein Haus in dem die Falken während der Mauser abgegeben werden können.

name: Abu Dhabi Falcon Hospital
review_text:
Tolle Führung mit vielen Informationen und Eindrücken. Absolut empfehlenswert.
Über Webseite der Klinik kann man einen Termin buchen und mit Taxi selbstständig hinfahren (auch wenn Klinik außerhalb und ab vom Schuss liegt) - funktioniert einwandfrei und ist günstiger. Im Anschluss bietet die Klinik auch nach der Tour an, ein Taxi zu rufen.
Während der Tour gibt es viele Informationen zu der Falkenjagd, der Aufzucht sowie dem Training der Tiere, frühere Entnahme der Falken aus der Wildnis und heutige Brutprogramme, Statussymbol, Krankheiten, Pflege, Pässe, Impfungen, Vorsorge, etc.
Dann darf man im Behandlungsraum der Untersuchung eines Falken beiwohnen, wo auch viel über Behandlungen erzählt wird. Am Ende darf man ein Foto mit Falken auf dem Arm machen.
Sehr interessantes Erlebnis und den Eintritt von 35€ locker wert.

name: Abu Dhabi Falcon Hospital
review_text:
Absolutely disappointed and heartbroken by my experience at Falcon Hospital.

I contacted them about my cat’s blocked bladder—a serious emergency. I was driving in from Dubai to Abu Dhabi, and clearly told them I could only reach after 6 PM. They confirmed it was fine under emergency hours and said it would cost around 275 AED for the visit and possibly around 3,000 AED for treatment, which I was ready to pay.

When I arrived, already stressed and scared for my cat, I asked to see the vet first. But instead of compassion, I was told bluntly by the receptionist to pay 3,000 upfront before the doctor would even see my cat. I asked how that was possible without even examining him—they had already made up the bill.

When the vet finally came out, his attitude was unbelievably cold and dismissive. He told me he “sees a thousand cases like mine every day” and refused to even touch my cat until I paid. I cannot express how awful that felt, standing there holding a suffering animal and being treated like a transaction.

And guess what? It wasn’t even what I feared. The condition was completely different. My cat is doing well now, but not because of their care—because I insisted on real answers and got him help. I ended up paying nearly 5,000 AED, and money wasn’t the issue—I was ready to do whatever it took.
But what I wanted was empathy, professionalism, and a vet who would talk to me like I was a human and my cat was a life—not a price tag.

Falcon Hospital failed me in every possible way that day.
You don’t treat pet owners like this in an emergency.
And you definitely don’t treat animals like that.

في إحدى الليالي، أنقذت قطًا من الشارع وكان في حالة حرجة. تواصلت مع المستشفى وأبلغوني أن الطبيب المناوب سيصل خلال نصف ساعة، فتوجهت فورًا بالقط إليهم. عند الوصول، كنت مضطرًا للعودة إلى عملي، وطلب مني الممرض دفع أكثر من ألف درهم كدفعة مقدمة قبل حتى أن يصل الطبيب أو يبدأ أي علاج.

لم تكن لدي مشكلة في الدفع، ولكن لسوء الحظ نسيت محفظتي. طلبت منهم أن يبدأوا بالعلاج وسأعود صباحًا لتسوية المبلغ، خاصة أن حياة القط كانت في خطر. لكنهم رفضوا استلام الحالة، رغم أنهم أخذوا القط إلى غرفة العلاج، وأصروا أن التعليمات من الإدارة تقضي بعدم استقبال أي حالة دون دفع مسبق.

اضطررت إلى أخذ القط إلى عيادة خاصة أخرى، ورغم أنهم ليسوا جهة حكومية، قبلوا الحالة فورًا وتعاملوا معها بإنسانية. لكن للأسف كان الأوان قد فات لإنقاذه.

رسالتي من هذه التجربة: إذا كنت تحب حيوانك الأليف وتعتبره فردًا من عائلتك، فلا أنصحك بالتوجه إلى مستشفى الصقور، خصوصًا في الحالات الحرجة. فبناءً على تجربتي وتجارب آخرين، حتى الحالات الروتينية قد تتحول إلى خسارة بسبب سوء الإدارة وقلة التعاطف.
ما يهمهم أولًا وأخيرًا هو تحصيل المال، وليس إنقاذ الأرواح.

قلبي ما زال يتألم على ما حدث، وأتمنى ألا يمر أحد بهذه التجربة. رجاءً، أخبروا أصدقاءكم ومحبي الحيوانات بعدم التعامل معهم.

I'm a cat rescuer , with over 30 cats under my care. I’ve dealt with most veterinary clinics across Abu Dhabi, and like any true pet lover, I consider my cats family — not just pets.

I'm sharing this painful experience with Falcon Veterinary Hospital from this perspective.

One night, I rescued a cat from the street in a critical condition. I called the hospital and was told the on-call doctor would arrive within 30 minutes, so I rushed the cat to them. Upon arrival, I had to return to work shortly after, but the attending nurse demanded an upfront payment of over AED 1,000 — before the doctor even arrived or treatment had started.

I was fully ready to pay, but unfortunately, I had forgotten my wallet. I kindly requested they begin treatment and promised to return in the morning to settle the bill, knowing the cat’s life was at risk. However, they refused to accept the case, despite already taking the cat into the treatment room, citing "management policy" that no treatment can start without prior payment.

I had no choice but to take the cat to a private clinic I work with — they are not even a government entity, yet they accepted the emergency immediately and showed empathy. Sadly, by the time we got there, it was too late to save the cat.

My message is this: if you truly love your pet and consider them family, I strongly advise against going to Falcon Vet Hospital, especially in emergencies. Based on my experience and that of others, even routine visits can lead to tragedy due to lack of compassion and poor management.

Their top priority is not the wellbeing of your pet — it’s your wallet.

My heart still aches for the loss of my cat. I hope no one else has to go through what I did. Please warn your loved ones and fellow animal lovers not to go there.

name: Fresh Basil (Dining In The Dark)
review_text:
I booked this experience to celebrate my friend’s birthday. I’ve tried the dining in the dark concept before and absolutely loved it. The idea of eating without seeing your food and relying on all your senses is truly special… but unfortunately, this visit was the complete opposite.

When we entered, there was a large group of mixed nationalities, a big crowd acting like they owned the place. They were extremely loud—laughing, shouting, and creating nonstop noise.
This experience requires focus, presence, and silence so you can actually taste, sense, and guess the ingredients… but we couldn’t even hear each other from how loud it was.

We politely asked them to lower their voices, but they completely ignored us. The worst part is that the staff did absolutely nothing. They didn’t try to calm the group down or manage the situation at all. Even when I told them we would leave if nothing changed, they still didn’t take any action.

Honestly, it was a very disappointing experience. I wouldn’t recommend anyone to book unless you know exactly how many people will be in the room with you, because clearly their priority now is packing the place and making money, not ensuring the real experience or guests’ comfort.

Definitely not going back like this.

name: Fresh Basil (Dining In The Dark)
review_text:
We had an unforgettable experience at Fresh Basil’s Dine in the Dark!

From the very beginning, our host Agung took such great care of us, especially of our daughter. He thoughtfully prepared coloring materials for her and even arranged a babysitter in case she felt uncomfortable in the dark. That level of attention truly made us feel at ease.

We started with a refreshing summer drink and delicious canapés. The canapés were our absolute favorite and set such a wonderful first impression.

Agung then guided us into the dark dining room with so much ease. We were lucky to be the only ones dining at that time, which turned the evening into a private and intimate experience.

The dishes prepared by Chef Naheed were nothing short of amazing. Every course felt like we were part of a blind-tasting competition from Culinary Wars- an exciting adventure for our senses! Our daughter enjoyed it most of all, and we’re so proud she was brave enough to dine in complete darkness.

A special highlight was the thoughtful surprise: a cake and an anniversary banner for our 8th wedding anniversary. It truly made the evening extra memorable.

Overall, the service, food, and experience were excellent. We highly recommend Fresh Basil Dine in the Dark for anyone looking for a unique and unforgettable dining adventure.

name: Fresh Basil (Dining In The Dark)
review_text:
Dining at Fresh Basil Restaurant for their Dining in the Dark experience was truly unforgettable. The concept itself is unique, and it completely transforms the way you enjoy food. Without relying on sight, every bite becomes more intense, allowing you to fully appreciate the rich flavors and amazing textures of each dish.

The food was extremely delicious — perfectly balanced, full of flavor, and crafted with creativity. Each course surprised us with bold taste combinations and a beautiful harmony of spices and freshness. It was more than just a meal, it was an experience that engaged all the senses.

The atmosphere was intimate and exciting, and the staff made the whole journey smooth, fun, and comfortable. If you’re looking for something different, memorable, and delicious, I highly recommend trying Dining in the Dark at Fresh Basil. It’s an adventure worth taking!

review_text:
We have dined on the dark before, but this experience was unmatched... positively incomparable!  Mr. Joel and his team, Meggie and Chef Bassant, handled everything eloquently, efficiently, and professionally from start to finish!  It was a dynamic, delectable dining experience, but Mr. Joel made it absolutely exquisite!

My 76-year-young Mom was visiting us to celebrate being cancer-free (alhumdulilah) for 11 years.  We informed the Fresh Basil team, and Mr. Joel and his team went above and beyond to celebrate her.

Before dinner, as our food was being prepared, we enjoyed a beverage and live music in the ground-level lounge.

Afterward, Mr. Joel led us to the Fresh Basil restaurant to a dimly-lit pre-dinner room where we enjoyed a delicious assortment of canapes prepared over burning sage coupled with a refreshing mocktail.  Mr. Joel thoroughly explained the dining in the dark concept.  After we secured our phones in the provided lock boxes, we were escorted to and seated one by one in the pitch-black dining room.  Then the palate phenomenon began!

We savored three courses of divine delight.  It was interesting and entertaining to discuss what we thought each dish was as we ate.

Afterward, Mr. Joel and his team surprised Mom with a cake that said "I am a survivor"!  How thoughtful and kind!  Our meal was then revealed to us, which was great.  We got a chance to see if our guesses were right; if our palates had fed us the right information.

This experience is one-of-a-kind!  I am grateful to have found a Groupon for it.  Otherwise,  I would not have known Fresh Basil AD existed.  BTW, all food allergies and dislikes are submitted before the dining experience, and the talented Chef Basant makes your meal according to your requests.

I am even more grateful for Mr. Joel and his dynamic team!  Mr. Joel truly uplifted my Mom and us!  Everything he did to make us feel welcomed and ensure we enjoyed every moment of our experience was noticed and is appreciated!  It's rare to meet anyone as genuine, altruistic, kindhearted, sincere, and professional as Mr. Joel; we are glad and fortunate we did!  We will be forever thankful to Mr. Joel and his team and will always remember our delicious Dinner in the Dark @ Fresh Basil AD!

name: Fresh Basil (Dining In The Dark)
review_text:
Dining in the Dark at @babalqasrhotel , is an absolutely surreal experience like none other. The essence of the concept of canceling out one of our key senses, Sight, to invoke our other senses, is really something one must try.

When we arrived at the restaurant, we were greeted by friendly staff who explained the entire concept of the Pitch Dark Dining.

During the briefing by Joel, we were served canapés with burnt rosemary at the bottom of the plate so as it invoke our body’s sensory receptors. Mr.Joel, who wore infrared night vision goggles and also our host for the night, patiently described every aspect of what we would be experiencing once we enter the pitch dark room and having a 3 course dinner meal.

He then led us to our table in the pitch dark room personally with our hands on his shoulders. Once we were seated he brought us our starters followed by the main course and then last but not the least, dessert.

Once we were done with our 3 course, Mr.Joel again escorted us out of the dark room, first into a room with very little light so our eyes can get adjusted before going into the light. Once we were outside in the briefing area of the restaurant, it was time for the big reveal by the chef of what we were served.

The experience of not being able to see the food that is served before you and just using your olfactory senses and gustatory senses to guess the taste, texture, ingredients and if possible the dish itself, is one of its kind.
I highly recommend this entire experience to all of you.
Indeed it’s a MUST-TRY.

name: Fresh Basil (Dining In The Dark)
review_text:
I'm not a Food Blogger nor a Restaurant Critic, however I want to share with you my experience with the new concept of "Dining in the Dark" at Bab Al Qasr Hotel - Abu Dhabi.
We were invited, my beautiful wife and I, by the one and only Elias Saad to a pre-launch dinner at the new restaurant "Fresh Basil - Pitch Black Dining" located in the five star hotel.
"Dining in the Dark"! a brand new concept in Abu Dhabi and the first of its kind in the city. A breath-taking whole experience that made us wonder what we loved the most, the luxurious location, the delicious food, the friendly service or the extraordinary Dark Room. It is indeed an amazing must try new experience, that I highly recommend.
Why am I so impressed? Well, being blindly seated by the waiter, served food that you can only smell and taste, wondering what the creative chef prepared for you is the answer.
When it comes to the socializing part, you find yourself sharing thoughts and ideas about the food with 15 other person in the dark room, without knowing to whom you are talking to. Electronic devices are not allowed!!!! Just chatting with each others! It's madness! It's an exciting weird yet fun experience to be lived with your friends and loved ones.
Kudos to Elias Saad and his amazing team!

name: Fresh Basil (Dining In The Dark)
review_text:
In my opinion, the place is overall a fun experience. I get anxiety at times and it was odd being in pitch black for an hour

No cameras.. no lights ... but plenty of action!

The food itself is awesome, true fine dining quality, but the real reason to visit is the unique experience which is like nothing I have done before and was one of those things that I would recommend anyone adding to your bucket list.

name: Hakkasan Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Our recent dinner at Hakkasan Abu Dhabi was, unfortunately, one of the most disappointing fine-dining experiences we have had anywhere in the world. We were a party of four, including two out-of-town guests we wanted to impress, and the evening fell far below the standards expected of a restaurant that proudly advertises a Michelin star.

From the beginning, the greeting was perfunctory and lacked any warmth. Our request for an outdoor table was declined due to a “private party,” yet we later saw multiple empty tables outside and guests being seated who clearly were not part of any large group. This immediately raised questions about the quality of service to come.

But the real shock came upon entering the dining room: Since when does a fine Chinese restaurant play thumping disco-style music? The background noise was so loud that we could not hold a normal conversation with our guests. Even after requesting the volume be lowered, nothing changed. This alone ruined any sense of atmosphere or refinement.

Service throughout the evening was equally disappointing. Our server seemed rushed and overwhelmed, offering no sense of attentiveness or hospitality. At one point, we waited nearly 15 minutes with empty plates on the table before anyone cleared them, and when someone finally came, there was no apology whatsoever. With the supposedly high caliber that Hakkasan claims, the service felt sub-par at best—no friendly greetings, no effort to engage, nothing beyond perfunctory “fast restaurant” interactions.

The food, sadly, did not redeem the evening. The dim sum and Peking duck were dry and surprisingly tasteless, far below expectations for a premium Chinese restaurant. We had ordered a pre-arranged set menu for the table, but the courses were rushed out so quickly that we had no time to enjoy them properly. Dish after dish appeared before we could finish the previous one, creating a hurried, uncomfortable pace that is the opposite of fine dining.

We left wondering how this Hakkasan location ever achieved a Michelin star. Between the loud nightclub-style music, inattentive service, lack of hospitality, and mediocre food, the entire experience was frankly embarrassing—especially with guests in town.

We will never return, and we cannot recommend this establishment to anyone seeking a genuine fine dining experience in Abu Dhabi.

name: Hakkasan Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Voor mijn verjaardag hadden we bij Hakkasan gereserveerd. Mooie setting, perfecte tafel, supervriendelijke bediening, het soort start waarbij je denkt: dit wordt een topavond.
Gezellig was het, absoluut. We kozen voor het degustatiemenu, want in een sterrenzaak is dat normaal de veilige keuze: achteroverleunen en je laten verrassen. Wel, verrast waren we:

Om te beginnen: geen hapjes. Helemaal niets. In een sterrenrestaurant. Vreemd, toch? Je verwacht toch minstens één klein welkomsthapje dat fluistert: “Welkom, we kunnen koken.”

Dan de opbouw van het menu: alle voorgerechten tegelijk, alle hoofdgerechten tegelijk. Echt niet leuk om alles op een hoop te krijgen — je wilt juist een avondvullend menu beleven, rustig opbouwen en genieten. Bovendien: veel te veel. We hebben heel wat onaangeroerd laten staan. Het leek soms wel op een chinees om de hoek, maar daar neem je de overschot dan wel mee naar huis.

En eerlijk? Geen enkel gerecht was echt top. Veel te veel gefrituurd, weinig finesse.

Voor een zaak met naam, faam én een stevig prijskaartje was dit een zware teleurstelling.
Geweldige avond dankzij de sfeer en de bediening, maar culinair gezien… nee, dit was het niet.

review_text:
Fine the crispy duck is salad is very good. Came right away.  I've now been waiting almost 45 minutes for a stir fried dish.  They've taken my napkin and a lot of people wandering around in dark clothes.   The restaurant is only at 20% filled.  No one has come to explain or assure me that my main course will be coming.  Totally ignored.  There's no way Michelin could give this place a star.  At this point I don't even care about the next course.  If it's coming.  Disappointing and totally wasting my time and goodwill.  Classic story.  Update.  OMFG.  Because I asked for the rest of my salad to take away, this server actually prepared my main course to go.  And it's been sitting in the bag with the salad for the last 30 minutes.  You cannot make this stuff up.  When have you ever had the rest of your first course saved to go and the rest of the meal was packed up without your knowledge.  It gets better.  While I'm waiting for dinner to be served she asks me if I want dessert. I lol at her like she's lost her mind.   Where's the main ?   And you're asking about dessert ?

Seriously, you have to go out of your way to create this kind of illogical chaos.  Michelin one star.  Seriously.

It's only been resolved, partially since I waved over an adult.  And told him my story.  I've never agin seen the person I gave my order to again.

The adult has comped the whole meal.  I was actually served the meal in a plate and it's very good.  And of course the twin is still in the bag.

Several dishes we ordered were forgotten completely, and when the staff finally attempted to bring them out, everyone else had already finished eating—at that point, what’s the point?

For a birthday celebration, I had to ask multiple times for them to bring out the cake I brought myself. When it finally came, it was dropped at the table without candles, plates, or even a knife—as if it were an afterthought. No care, no effort.

To make matters worse, there was no follow-up from a manager or even a proper apology. A simple explanation, a complimentary drink, or any acknowledgment would have gone a long way. Instead, the staff seemed indifferent.

Between the mediocre food and the lack of basic hospitality, this place completely missed the mark. There are plenty of better options in the area—do yourself a favor and explore those instead.

Came here for a couple drinks after dinner. It’s located downstairs from the lobby at Rosewood. You go down a spiral staircase lit with candles and then enter into the most amazing room. It’s pretty much a lounge in a wine cellar.

The decor and the atmosphere is fantastic. My dad is a massive wine fan and the selection impressed and so did the staff!

We got a welcome drink and the staff, a gentleman from Zimbabwe was super knowledgable, I’m fussy when it comes to wine and he selected one right to my tastes.

As an experience it’s genuinely one of the best bars I’ve been to in the UAE. We didn’t try the food but the menu looked great.

Will certainly be back!

name: La Cava
review_text:
My partner and I traveled all the way from Dubai to dine at La Cava, following a glowing recommendation and it did not disappoint. From the moment we stepped into the venue, it was clear this was going to be a special night.

The food? Absolutely insane. Every dish we tried was bursting with flavor. Whether you're a seasoned foodie or just love good Spanish food, La Cava delivers a culinary experience that exceeds expectations.

And the wine... what a selection. No matter which bottle you choose, you’re in for a treat. The wine list is top-tier, and what makes it even better is the staff’s knowledge — they clearly know and love what they’re serving. We especially appreciated the guidance we got from the team when picking our pairings.

A special mention must go to Paolo, the manager, whose warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail took the experience to another level. The entire service team was exceptional, friendly, and genuinely passionate.

To top it all off, we happened to visit on a flamenco night. The live Spanish music, the vibrant yet relaxed atmosphere, and the beautiful venue itself made the evening unforgettable.

Highly recommended to anyone who appreciates great food, outstanding wine, and unforgettable ambience.

name: La Cava
review_text:
La Cava is a attractive restaurant/wine bar located both on the ground level and wine cellar inside the Rosewood Hotel.  The wine cellar is hidden away down a spiral staircase.  Descending down the stairs, you feel as though you are being ushered to a secretive or exclusive hip hotspot.

My wife and I first visited La Cava about a week ago.  It was around 6 pm and we had the place to ourselves.  Our server was incredibly attentive, funny, and well-spoken.  He explained to us about about the 7 to 9 Grape & Cheese special, which we booked for later in the week when were leaving.  The music being played during this visit was pure classic jazz and truly fit the intimate setting of the cellar.  He explained that the Grape & Cheese nights were very popular and that the cellar would get very noisy and that we should take a look at the available seating upstairs.

We opted to reserve seating on the ground floor level for the next visit.  The area is nice and seating is spread out making it perfect when wanting to have a conversation.  This worked out perfectly when we had a guest join us for this evening.  The only issue was that the initial seating we had was really uncomfortable.  Our server quickly showed us to another area which was better.

He got our evening off with some bubbly and plates of finely sliced meats, an assortment of breads, and several types of cheese.  As the evening celebration unfolded we sampled a very nice Pinot Noir and a delectable dry Riesling.  With great conversation and wines flowing our two hours came to a end much quicker than expected.  Time seriously flew by...  Each night we have been there, the staff on hand has made us feel welcomed and well cared for. name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
review_text:
We went to Louvre Abu Dhabi, an annex of the Louvre Museum in Paris.
The surrounding area was crowded, but once inside the museum it wasn't so noticeable and I was able to enjoy the exhibits at my own pace.

It's not as large as the Louvre in France,
but there are a fair number of exhibits, so it will take some time to see everything.
Photography is permitted inside the museum.

We didn't have much time so we left after about an hour, but honestly it was a shame.
It's best to buy your tickets online in advance.
They're a little cheaper and allow for smoother entry.

name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
review_text:
The Louvre at Abu Dhabi is really only for those who are seriously interested in history, art, and most importantly, have the patience to read all the name plates and descriptions.

If not, it is a short walk through a very modern looking building that literally sits on the sea. There were some gorgeous, ancient sculptures, paintings, and even jewellery. There were so many ancient pieces from long dead civilizations with the only exception being the pieces from the Indian civilization (meaning the Indian civilization is the only one that survived to modern day). There were also more relatively contemporary works from the last 500 years.

name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
review_text:
The Louvre Abu Dhabi is a beautifully designed museum with a clean, post-modern layout. The iconic steel dome is both striking and practical — a perfect parasol under the sun. The experience feels immersive, with thoughtfully curated displays that guide you smoothly through history.

Highlights for me were the bulla, the statue of Ramses II, and the paintings of the Virgin Mary and other Christian relics — truly exquisite pieces. The museum connects cultures and eras effortlessly, making it both engaging and meaningful.

A must-visit in Abu Dhabi. Elegant, inspiring and genuinely memorable. 🏛️✨

name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Bu müzeyi grup turuyla ziyaret ettim. Dubai ve Abu Dabi’deki her şey gibi bu bina, harika bir zevk ve modern mimari sergiliyor. Burası Louvre adını kullanıyor ancak orijinaliyle rekabet etmeyi düşünmüyor. Sergiler çoğunlukla heykellerdir, ancak sergilerin düzenlemesi gözüme çok hoş geliyor. Akşam saatlerinde vardık ve onu görmek için yalnızca 2 saatimiz vardı. O yüzden kız arkadaşım ve ben hızımızı hızlandırdık ve oradaki her şeyi hızlı bir tempoda bile hayranlıkla izleyebildik.
Büyüleyici sergiler, sizi dünyanın farklı bölgelerini birbirine bağlayan, asırlarca süren bir arazi gezintisine çıkarır. Ekranların çoğu etkileşimliydi ve bu da deneyimi iyileştirdi.

Mamluklar, 1250-1517 yılları arasında büyülüydü; yükselmelerini, sanatları, kültürleri ve mirasıyla tarihe nasıl etki ettiğini gösteriyorlardı.

Biletler makul fiyatlıydı ve fiyatına kıyasla yüksek değer verdiğimi düşündüm. Kafe, hak ettiğiniz bir mola veriyor ve hediyelik eşya dükkânı hediyelik eşyalarla dolu. Otobüs veya taksi kullanmak çok kolay.

Personel cana yakın, yardımsever ve bilgili. Gezginlerin, farklı kültürlerin ve bölgelerin sanat ve tasarım yoluyla nasıl bir araya geldiğine dair bilgi edinmek için burayı ziyaret etmelerini tavsiye ederim.

name: Mezlai
review_text:
Specifically stopped by here to try the camel. The restaurant is located within Emirate Palace, which was a really beautiful place to look around. The palace reeked of opulence and extravagance which was very different from what I'm used to.
After getting to the restaurant with my booking, I was served doughnuts, dates and special coffee. The doughnuts were really amazing. I had the choice for inside or outdoor dining and opted to eat outside. The outdoor area had booths with very comfortable seats. After getting the menu I did feel like I was forgotten for a bit. Due to its location, it was hard to get anyone's attention without having to leave the table.
After getting to order, the item I wanted wasn't available so I ended with going with the other camel dish. I was also recommended the camel milk with dates.
The camel milk was interesting. It didn't have a strong milk flavour but that could have been due to the dates. It was kinda hard to drink though since the date pieces kept getting stuck in the straw.
I started with the veal harees, which was like a meat pate. The meat was spiced very delicately but the texture was a bit weird for me, almost gummy. It did go really well with the pita bread. The pita bread was delicious. I found the camel chop a bit dry. The vegetables that came with it were seasoned and cooked well.
I had the angel hair and kashta for dessert. There was a pistachio and honey parfait on one side and angel hair filled with cream and topped with chocolate on the other. Both items were nice.
The food was made well but it wasn't something that I would go for again, particularly due to the price. Service was really nice when they were there, but that could have been due to the time, as I arrived there quite late (2130). Overall it was an interesting experience.

query: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque Abu Dhabi
name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
review_text:
Visitare la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed ad Abu Dhabi è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e profonde del mio viaggio negli Emirati Arabi Uniti. Non è solo una tappa panoramica, ma una delle attrazioni culturali e spirituali più impressionanti del mondo moderno. Appena ci si avvicina, la sua facciata in marmo bianco immacolato con oltre 80 cupole e minareti imponenti è mozzafiato, un vero simbolo di Abu Dhabi che combina architettura islamica tradizionale e maestosità contemporanea. All’interno, la sala di preghiera principale lascia senza parole: il gigantesco tappeto fatto a mano (il più grande del mondo), i lampadari decorati con cristalli e i dettagli in foglia d’oro creano un’atmosfera di bellezza e pace difficili da descrivere. La luce sul marmo e le piscine riflettenti rendono la moschea ancora più spettacolare al tramonto o alla sera, quando le ombre giocano sui mosaici e i colori cambiano gradualmente.
Visitare questo luogo ti fa pensare sia all’arte e all’architettura, sia alla cultura e alla spiritualità che ispira milioni di persone ogni giorno. È importante ricordare di seguire il dress code rispettoso richiesto per l’accesso (spalle e gambe coperte, e per le donne anche testa coperta), una regola che contribuisce al senso di rispetto all’interno di un luogo di culto attivo. Per me la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed è una delle meraviglie architettoniche più belle che abbia visto, un luogo dove la grandiosità incontra la serenità. Che tu sia religioso o meno, la visita è emozionante, istruttiva e visivamente straordinaria, una tappa assolutamente da non perdere ad Abu Dhabi. Entra con calma al mattino presto o al tramonto per un’esperienza più tranquilla e fotografie spettacolari!

review_text:
Allereerst: waarom slechts 3 sterren, terwijl het een fantastisch mooi gebouw is?

Ongeveer 10 jaar geleden waren we ook in Abu Dhabi en zijn met een taxi naar de moskee gereden. Mijn vrouw kon ter plekke een chador lenen, tas controleren, door een poortje en je stond op het plein voor de moskee.

Vanwege covid worden er geen chadors meer uitgeleend (begrijpelijk). Dus zijn er winkeltjes waar je voor een bescheiden bedrag bedekkende kleding kunt kopen. So far so good.

Alleen toen we drie weken geleden met een tour vanuit Dubai aankwamen bleek dat er een compleet ondergronds winkelcentrum is gebouwd, inclusief foodcourt met Burgerking...

Onbegrijpelijk dat men zo'n prachtig religieus gebouw op deze manier heeft omgebouwd tot een soort Efteling.

Heel jammer!

Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi’nin ve hatta dünyanın en etkileyici yapılarından biri. Mimarisindeki zarafet, bembeyaz mermerlerin ihtişamı ve detaylardaki ince işçilik insanı ilk anda büyülüyor. İçeri adım attığınız anda huzur, saygı ve hayranlık duygusu aynı anda hissediliyor. Gerek gündüz gerek akşam ışıklandırmasıyla bambaşka bir atmosfere bürünen bu muazzam yapı, hem manevi hem görsel olarak unutulmaz bir deneyim sunuyor.

Küçük ama önemli bir not: girişte kıyafet kurallarına özellikle dikkat ediliyor. Transparan ve uygun olmayan kıyafetlerle içeri alınmıyor. Hatta bizden oldukça garip bir şekilde çorap giymemizi bile istemişlerdi 😄 Bu detayı bilerek gitmekte fayda var. Abu Dhabi’ye yolu düşen herkesin mutlaka görmesi gereken, gerçekten ikonik bir eser. 🤍✨

name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
review_text:
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is absolutely breathtaking and one of the most unforgettable places i have ever visited — truly a must visit.

the scale of this mosque is incredible. it covers a huge area of about 22 400 square meters (about the size of five football fields) and can welcome tens of thousands of worshippers, with its elegant architecture and peaceful atmosphere inspiring awe the moment you arrive.  ￼

everywhere you look, the details are insane. the walls and columns are inlaid with marble and semi‑precious stones such as lapis lazuli, amethyst, mother‑of‑pearl and red agate — every piece of craftsmanship feels like art.  ￼

inside, the centerpiece is the world’s largest hand‑knotted carpet, covering over 5 600 square meters and weighing around 35 tons — a masterpiece woven by more than a thousand artisans with billions of knots of wool and cotton.  ￼

the chandeliers are equally stunning, studded with millions of crystals, and reflect light in the most beautiful way. the patterns on the floors and ceilings, the gold accents, the geometry — it all comes together in such a harmonious and majestic design that you can’t help but say wow, just wow.  ￼

overall, this mosque is not just a building, it’s a work of art and devotion, with every detail crafted to perfection. if you find yourself in abu dhabi, you absolutely have to see it — it will leave you speechless.

name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
review_text: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is one of those places that leaves a strong impression without trying too hard. The architecture is beautiful, especially for a relatively modern structure, with an incredible level of detail throughout. The mosque is immaculately maintained, and the open, expansive spaces make the visit feel calm and unhurried. Everything is very well organised, with a smooth and well managed flow from entry to exit. The only slightly tiring part is the amount of walking involved, which can be a bit much if you are visiting with toddlers or elderly family members. However, buggies are available and help make the experience much easier. Overall, it is a thoughtfully managed and memorable place to visit in Abu Dhabi.

name: Prison Island Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Prison Island was really fun. There were 26 rooms with different specialties, and they required different skills. For example, some rooms required more skill like the basketball game, some required strength like Shark Bay, and some required brains like the Einstein room. I went with my friends, and it was very worth it, especially with other people.

The price felt very reasonable for the experience. There were six of us and we played for two hours, which was a lot of fun. Each person was supposed to pay 200, but thanks to a voucher we only paid 100, which made it an even better deal overall. If you are going with a group larger than 5, I recommend splitting yourselves into groups of 2-3, since most rooms are designed for 1–3 players and some rooms require exactly 3. It wouldn’t be fun if everyone was in the same group because it would be chaotic.

We split into groups of 3, and our experience was really fun. I recommend this place if you want to feel adventurous while having fun with your friends.

name: Qasr Al Muwaiji - قصر المويجعي
review_text:
Qasr Al Muwaiji is one of those places that quietly humbles you. Set within a restored historic fort in Al Ain, it once served as both the residence and administrative center of the Al Nahyan family — and most notably, the birthplace of Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan. This is where the story of modern UAE leadership truly begins.

The fort has been beautifully preserved in its original style, allowing you to step straight into the past. Walking through its corridors gives a grounded, almost intimate glimpse into how life once was — simple, resilient, and purpose-driven. The exhibits trace the nation’s journey from humble beginnings to remarkable progress under the steady leadership of the Al Nahyan family, especially the vision of the late Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan.

With free entry and an immersive, thoughtfully curated experience, Qasr Al Muwaiji isn’t flashy — it’s sincere, meaningful, and quietly powerful. A must-visit if you want to understand the soul behind the nation. 🏰✨

name: Qasr Al Muwaiji - قصر المويجعي
review_text:
قصر المويجعي واحد من المعالم اللي تحسّ إنها تحكي تاريخ المكان بصمت، وتجمع بين الأصالة وهيبة الماضي. من أوّل ما تدخل القصر، بتشوف الطراز الأصيل اللي يميّز العمارة الإماراتية القديمة، الجدران الطينية، والساحات الواسعة اللي تعكس بساطة الحياة زمان وجمالها.

القصر له قيمة خاصة لأنه شهد ميلاد صاحب السمو الشيخ خليفة بن زايد آل نهيان رحمه الله، وبهذا يتحوّل من مجرد مبنى أثري إلى شاهد على مرحلة مهمة من تاريخ الدولة. المعرض الداخلي مرتب بطريقة ذكية، يشرح لك قصة المكان، ويعرض صور ووثائق تحسسّك بقربك من الأحداث والشخصيات اللي صنعت تاريخ الإمارات.

الإضاءة الهادئة، العروض التفاعلية، والممرات المفتوحة على الساحة الداخلية تعطّي الزائر تجربة ممتعة، خصوصًا إذا كنت من محبين الأماكن اللي فيها روح وذاكرة. حتى الصوتيات داخل بعض القاعات مصممة لتعطيك إحساس بالغوص في الماضي.

الجميل بعد إن القصر قريب من العين مول ومنطقة وسط العين، يعني تقدر تزوره ضمن يوم سياحي كامل بدون تعب. المكان مناسب للعائلات، وممتع لهواة التصوير، والزيارة فيه ما تاخذ وقت طويل، لكنها تترك انطباع عميق.

review_text:
قصر المويجعي في العين هو موقع تاريخي محوري ومسقط رأس المغفور له الشيخ خليفة بن زايد آل نهيان. القصر هو حصن تاريخي مُرمم، يعرض قصص أسرة آل نهيان وتاريخ المنطقة. إنه مركز ثقافي يُقدم المعارض والفعاليات باستمرار.
الإنجليزية (English)
Al Muwaiji Palace in Al Ain is a pivotal historical site and the birthplace of the late Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The Palace is a restored historic fort, showcasing the stories of the Al Nahyan family and the region's history. It serves as a cultural centre that continually hosts exhibitions and events.
الفرنسية (French)
Le Palais Al Muwaiji à Al Ain est un site historique central et le lieu de naissance du défunt Cheikh Khalifa ben Zayed Al Nahyan. Ce fort historique restauré raconte l'histoire de la famille Al Nahyan et celle de la région. Il fonctionne comme un centre culturel qui organise régulièrement des expositions et des événements.
الروسية (Russian)
Дворец Аль-Мувайджи в Аль-Айне — это ключевой исторический объект и место рождения покойного шейха Халифы бен Заида Аль Нахайяна. Этот отреставрированный исторический форт демонстрирует историю семьи Аль Нахайян и историю региона. Он служит культурным центром, регулярно проводящим выставки и мероприятия

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
La visita a Qasr Al Watan, il Palazzo Presidenziale degli Emirati Arabi Uniti ad Abu Dhabi, è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e memorabili del mio viaggio. Questo luogo non è una semplice attrazione turistica, ma un monumento culturale e simbolico che racconta la storia, l’arte, la conoscenza e la visione del Paese. Appena arrivi ti resta impressa la facciata maestosa in granito bianco e pietra, con dettagli lavorati e decorazioni che esprimono lusso e identità araba. La struttura è enorme e ogni sala, corridoio o galleria ha un impatto visivo impressionante, soprattutto la Great Hall con il suo enorme lampadario, che ti lascia davvero senza parole. Entrare qui significa fare un viaggio nella storia e nei valori degli Emirati. Ci sono esposizioni che illustrano l’evoluzione politica e sociale del Paese, oggetti diplomatici, e una biblioteca ricca di testi rari che riflette la profonda attenzione alla conoscenza e alla cultura.
Una delle parti più belle della visita è lo spettacolo di luci e suoni “Palace in Motion” che si tiene in serata: la facciata del palazzo si trasforma in un enorme schermo che racconta, con proiezioni e musica, la storia e le aspirazioni degli Emirati. È un momento suggestivo e molto scenografico. Mi raccomando, pantaloni lunghi o gonne sotto il ginocchio, perché è un luogo istituzionale. Prenota il biglietto in anticipo per evitare code, soprattutto nei periodi di alta stagione. Dedica almeno 1–2 ore se vuoi esplorare bene le sale e vivere anche lo spettacolo serale. Per me Qasr Al Watan non è solo un palazzo, ma un’esperienza culturale e visiva che racconta l’anima degli Emirati, ricca di architettura spettacolare, storia e tradizione. È un must se visiti Abu Dhabi, e la sua maestosità ti rimane impressa molto dopo che te ne sei andato.

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
Der Qasr Al-Watan ist ein absoluter Traumpalast, den man bei einem Besuch in Abu Dhabi unbedingt besichtigen sollte.

Eintritt: die Eintrittskarten können ausschließlich online gekauft werden, und an der Kasse muss dann der QR-Code vorgezeigt werden.

Sicherheitskontrolle: obwohl der Palast von sehr vielen Menschen besucht wurde, ging die Sicherheitskontrolle erstaunlicherweise schnell voran, und nach der Sicherheitskontrolle werden alle Besucher mit Bussen zum Haupteingang gefahren.

Benötigte Besuchszeit: planen Sie für die Besichtigung des Qasr Al-Watan, mindestens 1 1/2 - 2 Stunden ein, da es abgesehen von dem Palast selbst, auch interessante Ausstellungsräume zu besichtigen gibt, in denen dem Besucher zum Beispiel Geschenke zu repräsentiert werden, die dem Herrscher von Abu Dhabi wären Staatsbesuchen gemacht wurden. Eine kleine Ausstellung thematisiert auch die Geschichte der Raumfahrt in den vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten, und auch die Besichtigung des Bankett, sowie einer Ausstellung über Kalligraphie, sind sehr sehenswert im Qasr Al-Watan.

Tipp: Abends um 19:15 Uhr gibt es vor dem Palast eine Lichtershow, die sie unbedingt sehen sollten!
