name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
Qasr Al Watan — это настоящий дворец-шедевр в Абу-Даби, который невозможно забыть. Открытый для публики в 2019 году  и поражает как масштабами, так и утончённой красотой.

С первых минут понимаешь: здесь каждая деталь произведение искусства. Главный зал с куполом диаметром 37 метров и высотой 60 метров парит над тобой, как небесный свод. Стены украшены тончайшими орнаментами в бело-золотой гамме, выполненными вручную, а мрамор, привезённый из лучших уголков мира, сияет в солнечном свете.

Залы дворца - это отдельные миры. Hall of Knowledge хранит редкие книги и манускрипты, Banquet Hall впечатляет столами длиной 120 метров, а Gift Hall демонстрирует изысканные подарки мировых лидеров. Огромные люстры, каждая весом несколько тонн, свисают как каскады звёзд.

Qasr Al Watan - это не просто туристическая достопримечательность, а символ культуры и роскоши ОАЭ. Если вы хотите увидеть восточный люкс в его высшем проявлении, прикоснуться к величию архитектуры и почувствовать себя частью чего-то грандиозного -это место обязательно для посещения

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text: An enormous presidential palace, absolutely stuffed with lots of swishiness!  The scale and opulence of this palace is unbelievable, especially as it is only used for meetings and no one lives there!  You need to catch the free shuttle bus to get to the palace, and also have your bags scanned/checked.  No big deal all this is done very efficiently and quickly, bus ride is only a few minutes.  Once inside you will see how huge and cavernous the palace is,  there are a few restricted areas and some rooms you can only look through the door.  Speaking of doors, the main doors are massive and apparently weigh something like 50 tons!  Some rooms have small exhibitions of artifacts, costumes etc.  The library is huge as you would expect, although the shelves are not completely full!  There are some pleasant garden areas and a water fountain, accessible to tourists too.  1-2 hours should be enough time for your visit.

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
(2025.11.) 입장권을 현장에서 구매하면 75디르함으로 인터넷 구매보다 비쌉니다. 저는 마이**트립으로 구매했는데 1만 7천원 정도였습니다. 사전 구매하면 QR코드가 있는 pdf 파일을 받게 되는데 입장 시 방문객센터 오른쪽의 Ticket Counter가 아닌 왼쪽 문으로 바로 들어가면 됩니다.
아부다비 왕가의 장엄함을 그대로 보여 주는 건물입니다. 아랍의 전통미를 반영한 하얀색과 금색의 조화가 매우 뛰어납니다. 셰이크 자이드 그랜드 모스크와 유사한 분위기이면서도 국가 의전에 쓰이는 건물다운 면모도 보입니다.
건물 자체도 뛰어나지만 국가 정상 간에 주고 받은 선물이라든지 아랍 문자에 관한 전시 등 다른 볼거리도 많습니다. 우리나라에서 선물한 도자기, 자개, 단도 등이 다른 나라의 선물들과 함께 전시되어 있어 흥미로웠습니다.

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
Visiting Qasr Al Watan was an unforgettable experience from start to finish. Everything was organized beautifully, beginning with the ease of online booking—the process was smooth, quick, and straightforward, which made planning the visit completely hassle-free.

Upon arrival, the experience only got better. The shuttle bus that takes you to the palace entrance was comfortable and well-managed, setting the tone for the high level of hospitality you feel throughout the visit.

Stepping inside the palace is like entering another world. The architecture, details, and craftsmanship are absolutely breathtaking. Every hall tells a story, and every corner reflects the rich heritage and vision of the UAE.

Walking through the different halls was truly mesmerizing—each space more impressive than the one before. But the highlight of the visit for me was the Presidential Gifts Hall. Seeing the collection of gifts presented to the UAE from leaders around the world was fascinating. Every piece carries deep meaning and represents a moment of diplomacy, friendship, and respect between nations.

Overall, Qasr Al Watan offers a perfect combination of culture, history, and beauty. If you're visiting Abu Dhabi or even living in the UAE, this is a must-see landmark. The entire experience was seamless, enriching, and simply amazing.
Highly recommended!

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
Het presidentieel paleis

Qasr Al Watan is zonder twijfel één van de meest indrukwekkende bezienswaardigheden van Abu Dhabi. Ga zeker met zonsondergang: vooral buiten is het fenomenaal mooi. In het warme licht van de ondergaande zon voelt het alsof je in een scène uit Aladdin terechtkomt.

Binnen is het “groot, groter, grootst”. De zalen zijn stijlvol ingericht in wit, geel en lichtblauw, zo groots en verfijnd dat je het amper kunt bevatten.

Blijf vooral tot na zonsondergang om de Palace in Motion lichtshow mee te pikken. Die is absoluut de moeite waard. Check wel vooraf de tijden online, want die veranderen per maand. Onze originele reservatie werd enkele dagen op voorhand geannuleerd door een ceremonieel bezoek, maar we konden gelukkig nog verplaatsen.

Een majestueuze ervaring die je niet snel vergeet.

query: Qasr Al Sarab Desert Resort by Anantara Abu Dhabi
name: Qasr Al Sarab Desert Resort by Anantara
review_text:
Poor service almost ruined our beautiful staycation.

We were 2 families who checked in for 2 nights. We took the half-board option and went for dinner at their Ghadeer Restaurant near the pool. We felt far from welcome at the restaurant. We wanted a table set up for 6 nearby the pool. Most tables were empty as we came in at around 9pm for dinner. Even then, the staff (especially 2) were least bothered and looked annoyed about us wanting to join and make a table at a particular spot.

After several reminders (we were ignored and not attended to for about 10 minutes) they finally bothered to arrange the tables. Service was poor and this somewhat ruined our mood for the remaining period of our stay.

We did address this issue to the restaurant manager Ms. Vardha who did her best to make our dinner a better experience but we were definitely bothered by the earlier experience. Food was amazing. Good portions and desserts were great.

We also addressed these issues to Mr. Manish the next day. And he took his best efforts to ensure that we would not face any issues for the remaining part of our stay.

The breakfast was great. The spread and service was great. There's an outdoor option as well.

The rooms are very good and clean. The only problem we had was ... No power sockets near the bed.

I would recommend everyone to have dinner at the Al Falaj desert restaurant for a memorable dinner (if the weather is pleasant). Great ambience and food.

Even at checkout there was an issue. I was told there was a pending amount to be paid. I was confused because it was a fully paid booking from the Anantara website directly. I paid the 'balance amount' then but when I contacted reservations by email, I got a reply saying it was a mistake and it would be refunded. All these mistakes did not look good and it looks like there is a mismanagement issue at several levels.

Special thanks to Mr. Omnath (stargazing spot drive) and Mr. Dame (great photo at the main gate after our checkout) from the buggy team.

The room was beautifully decorated, the private terrace had the most breathtaking views, and the attention to detail was on another level. They surprised us with heartfelt touches that genuinely moved us,  something you can’t buy or request. It comes from true hospitality.

The sunset over the desert? Unreal.
The dinner under the stars? A memory we will tell our kids about.
The service? Perfection, warm, discreet, and deeply caring.

Every staff member we met made us feel welcomed, celebrated, and valued.
It felt like they were proud we chose Qasr Al Sarab for our special occasion, and they made sure every second was magical.

We left with full hearts, incredible photos, and a promise to come back.

Thank you, Anantara team, for giving us the most unforgettable anniversary of our lives.
You created a memory that will stay with us forever.

If you’re reading this:

Don’t hesitate, book it.

This is the definition of timeless luxury.

A Dream Come True at Qasr Al Sarab Anantara.

Staying at Qasr Al Sarab Anantara was truly a dream come true. The hotel itself is breathtaking, from the architecture to the serene atmosphere, but what made the experience unforgettable were the people and the activities.
We booked a private early-morning desert drive, and our guide, Shehzad, made it one of the best experiences of our lives. He was not only incredibly knowledgeable about the region, but also shared fascinating stories and behind-the-scenes. His passion, kindness, and storytelling turned the whole trip into something magical.
Every activity we tried, sunrise drives, photography spots, desert walks, and more, was organized perfectly. The hotel staff went above and beyond to make sure everything felt personal and memorable.
Qasr Al Sarab is one of those rare places where nature, luxury, and human warmth come together seamlessly. I can’t recommend it enough, and if you visit, make sure to request Shehzad as your guide. He will turn an unforgettable trip into an extraordinary one.

review_text:
We had an absolutely amazing stay at Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi, and the experience exceeded our expectations in every possible way.

First of all, the rooms were exceptionally clean. Not just upon arrival, but throughout the entire stay. Housekeeping did an outstanding job every day, and the level of cleanliness really stood out. Everything felt fresh, well-maintained, and truly luxurious, which made the stay extremely comfortable.

The food was insanely good. The quality, variety, and presentation were on a very high level. Every meal felt well thought out, with delicious flavors and excellent ingredients. Whether it was breakfast, lunch, or dinner, the dining experience was consistently impressive. The drinks were also excellent — well-made, flavorful, and served with great attention to detail.

One of the absolute highlights of our stay was the New Year’s show, which was simply amazing. The entertainment, atmosphere, and overall organization were outstanding and created an unforgettable celebration. It was clear that a lot of effort and professionalism went into making the evening special for the guests.

The service was excellent from start to finish. A special mention goes to Caner at the reception, who was incredibly polite, professional, and helpful. From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. Caner handled everything with a smile and great courtesy, which made a big difference and set the tone for the entire stay.

Overall, Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi delivers a top-level hotel experience with spotless rooms, outstanding food and drinks, unforgettable entertainment, and truly exceptional service. We would highly recommend this hotel and would absolutely love to return in the future.

name: Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Zunächst war ich mir nicht sicher, ob ich eine Rezension schreiben möchte, da es während unseres Aufenthalts zu einer Unstimmigkeit gekommen ist. Der Umgang des Hotelpersonals mit dieser Situation hat mich jedoch positiv überrascht, sodass ich mich entschieden habe, unsere sehr schönen Erfahrungen zu teilen.

Besonders beeindruckt hat uns das hervorragende Essen: Sowohl das Frühstücks- als auch das Abendbuffet waren äußerst vielfältig, abwechslungsreich und qualitativ. Die Auswahl liess keine Wünsche offen, und die Speisen waren stets frisch und ansprechend zubereitet. Positiv hervorzuheben ist zudem, dass man rund um die Uhr sehr gut verpflegt wird; selbst ohne ein All-Inclusive-Paket zu buchen.

Ein weiterer grosser Pluspunkt ist das Hotelpersonal. Alle Mitarbeitenden waren durchweg sehr höflich, aufmerksam und hilfsbereit. Man hatte jederzeit das Gefühl, willkommen zu sein und ernst genommen zu werden.

Auch das Zimmer hat uns sehr überzeugt: Es war modern, gepflegt und sauber. Das Housekeeping hat hervorragende Arbeit geleistet. Den respektvollen Umgang mit unseren persönlichen Sachen haben wir als sehr angenehm empfunden.

Die Lage des Hotels ist ebenfalls hervorragend. Direkt am Meer gelegen, hat es den Aufenthalt besonders erholsam gemacht.

Die erwähnte Unstimmigkeit konnte gemeinsam mit dem Hotelpersonal schnell und unkompliziert geklärt werden. Dabei wurde deutlich, wie lösungsorientiert dort gearbeitet wird und wie wichtig es dem Hotel ist, dass die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt als positiv in Erinnerung behalten und mit einem guten Gefühl abreisen.

Insgesamt sehr zu empfehlen.

name: Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Wir waren hier im April mit unseren 6 jährigen Zwillingen und hatten Halbpension gebucht.

Eines vorab - das Hotel ist wirklich beeindruckend und vermutlich nicht vergleichbar mit anderen Hotels im klassischen Abu Dhabi. Unter Berücksichtigung von Preis-Leistung habe ich jedoch eine andere Erwartungshaltung, weshalb ich nur 4 Sterne vergebe.

Der Check-In ist verbesserungsfähig - wobei mme. etwas unglücklich. Nach der Ankunft und Abgabe unserer Pässe wurden wir gefragt, ob wir den Check In auf Deutsch vornehmen wollen. Meine Frau bejahte - ich vermute der einzig deutschsprachige Mitarbeiter hatte gerade Pause und war entsprechend gelaunt. - Infos? Fehlanzeige. Zudem wurde dadurch der Check In Prozess ziemlich verzögert. Daneben war das Extrabett noch nicht vorbereitet - bei einem Check In nach 15 Uhr sollte man erwarten können, dass das Zimmer bereits vorbereitet ist.

Ebenfalls nicht optimal empfand ich unser Zimmer mit Meerblick - unter unserem Zimmer gab es Balkone, weshalb wir einen Sichtschutz hatten. Diesen haben sehr wenige Zimmer. Daneben war das Zimmer sehr geräumig und bat ausreichend Platz für uns vier. Ebenfalls negativ - es gibt eigentlich keine Möglichkeit die Badesachen an der Luft / Sonne zu trocknen.

Die Essensauswahl ist sehr groß und abwechslungsreich. In der besagten Preisklasse erwarte ich jedoch einen gewissen Mindestservice bei der Bedienung am Tisch - insbesondere beim Frühstück (Aufnahme Bestellung Getränke, Eierspeisen etc.). Abends gibt es einen Live-grill mit diversen Fleisch- und Fischsorten - leider wiederholt sich die Auswahl stets und wurde nur punktuell ersetzt.

Besonders hervorheben möchten wir den Kids-Club. Unsere Kinder haben diesen geliebt - und einen Mitarbeiter aus einem anderen Hotel aus 2024 wiedererkannt. Die Betreuer sind super, jeden Tag gibt es ein anderes Motto und verschiedene Aktivitäten. Auch abends gibt es neben der Minidisco viel Abwechslung für die Kinder. Besonders erfreulich - anstatt permanent Süßkram zu geben, gab es an einem Abend frische Kokosnüsse sowie wurde Sushi selbst gemacht. Am letzten Tag gab es zudem ein Abschiedsgeschenk. - hier wird in die Gäste von morgen investiert ;-)

Auch für Erwachsene gibt es diverse Aktivitäten. Am Strand und Pool gibt es alternativ ausreichend liegen, sodass man hier nie das Gefühl haben muss, welche zu reservieren.

In der unmittelbaren Nähe vom Hotel gibt es ein "Dorf", welches das authentische Leben in den VAE vor dem "Geldregen" zeigt sowie eine Mall mit Shopping- und Essensmöglichkeiten.
Für weitere Aktivitäten (tagsüber, z.B. Stadttour, YAS-Island) verpasst man zu viele Möglichkeiten, da diese doch etwas weit entfernt sind vom Hotel.

Ein letztes Manko - wobei Jammern auf hohem Niveau. Da wir über einen Reiseveranstalter gebucht hatten, wurde unser Accorhotels Status nicht gewürdigt.

name: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island
review_text:
Wow, das Hotel ist einfach top und wunderschön!! Wir waren Ende November für 8 Nächte dort (in einer One Bedroom Suite) und es hat uns so gut gefallen, dass wir dieses Jahr nochmals dorthin möchten.

Wir haben lediglich folgende Kritikpunkte (der Rest verdient absolut 10 von 10 Punkten):

- Die Musiklautstärke war viel zu hoch! V.a. während der abendlichen Show im Kinderclub, wärend der Wassergymnastik am Pool, und während der abendlichen DJ-Performance am Strand. Mein Mann, spezialisiert u.a. auf Hörverlust, meinte, der Lautstärke-Grenzwert sei jeweils um ein Vielfaches überschritten gewesen. Unsere Tochter musste abends bei der Kinderclub-Show immer einen Kopfhörer (als Hörschutz) tragen und wir haben uns immer die Ohren zugehalten…
- Die Wassertemperatur des Hauptpools könnte min. 2 Grad wärmer sein (er war 29 Grad, was dazu führte, dass man ohne ständige Bewegung etwas kalt bekam. 31 Grad wären perfekt gewesen, um länger baden zu können).
- Auch die Pooltemperatur des Kinder-Wasserparks war sooo kalt, dass unsere Tochter (und wir) nicht lange dort bleiben wollten). Das ist vermutlich auch der Grund, weshalb dort fast nie Kinder sind (was schade ist, weil der Wasserpark wirklich schön ist); alle Kinder sind meist im Hauptpool, weil der natürlich einiges wärmer ist.

Bis auf diese Kritikpunkte ist das Hotel traumhaft! Der Service des gesamten Personals ist TOP! Die Auswahl und Qualität in allen Restaurants ebenfalls.

Wir freuen uns schon sehr auf unseren nächsten Aufenthalt!

query: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island Abu Dhabi
name: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island
review_text:
This was our 2nd visit to Rixos Saadiyat, first was November 2024. We really enjoyed our first stay so much that we came back.  Was really nice that some of the staff recognised us and the service was excellent from all throughout our stay.

Some nice upgrades to the loungers at the pool and the cooler boxes are a great idea.

Nice addition to the DJ set up at the beach bar with the mirrored setting.  The vibe created at the beach bar is amazing getting really chilled for sunset; however the music set could be changed daily as it gets repetitive,  sounds more like a preset playlist rather than a proper DJ set.

Evening entertainment is in a great setting in the outdoor area,  well organised and the vibe is very chilled,  however the bands playing this year were all virtually identical with all playing the same songs,  it began to get repetitive.

Buffet provided ample choice and had something for everyone.

We dined at Aja, Orient, Mermaid and L'Olivio and all were excellent,  food was delicious and really good choice on the menus. Staff service at all was first class.

Highlights pool bar was excellent, thanks to all the guys who knew exactly what we were drinking and kept us topped up all day, special mention to KB for introducing us to a particular rum cocktail.

Bar lounge was excellent with a great selection of drinks and great staff constantly on the go ensuring we were taken care of.

Overall great stay,  we highly recommend 👌
owner_answer:
Dear Mr. Mark James,

Thank you for sharing your feedback regarding your recent experience at Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island. We are delighted to learn that you returned for a second visit and that our staff made a positive impression by recognizing you. It is gratifying to hear that you enjoyed the upgrades to our amenities and the atmosphere created at the beach bar.

We appreciate your input on the music selection at the beach bar and the evening entertainment. Your comments regarding the repetitiveness of the playlists and performances will be taken into consideration as we continuously strive to enhance our guest experiences. We are pleased that you found the buffet and the dining options at Aja, Orient, Mermaid, and L'Olivio to be excellent, as well as the service provided by our dedicated staff.

Thank you for your generous recommendation. We hope to welcome you back for another wonderful stay in the future.

Best regards,
Guest Relations Team

review_text:
Очень приятный отель. Прекрасный, доброжелательный и крайне внимательный персонал. На территории и в номерах очень чисто. Чудесное постельное белье. Еда выше всяких похвал, на любой вкус .
Мы просили за месяц до прибывания, чтобы нам сделали номера рядом и на первом этаже , за меся это вполне возможно организовать. Однако, оказалось, что эта информация не дошла до отеля и ресепшен. Но сотрудники нам помогли и сделали номер на первом этаже, рядом не получилось, мои друзья жили выше….
Это было немного странно, что информацию никто не передал и выглядело , просто как игнорирование просьбы , за фразой «мы сделаем всё, что возможно» .  Но сотрудники ресепшен Любовь, всё исправила.
То что люди , которые выезжают из отеля позже 12 дня , не могут пойти на обед, выглядит, как то странно, про том количестве еды , что остается .
Нас это тоже не коснулось. Но для других, я полагаю это важно и может испортить впечатление об отдыхе.
Мы вернемся на следующий год ещё большей компанией .
Спасибо.

review_text: This hotel is a dream come true! The infrastructure is dreamy, very well designed. The gardens, the pools are kept very clean and the care of the facility is great! Not only is it baby friendly, we were provided with much care and support from everyone. We were provided with a baby bottle sterilizer, a cod (but you can cosleep since there is no gap in the bed and the beds are big enough), they even have strollers to lend out. If you have bigger kids there is a babysitting service (if I’m not mistaken from 1 year old onwards) and a kids club with a baby/ kids pool. We also recommend getting massages (special thanks to Oxana who is a wonderful massage therapist). The spa has won many awards and we agree that it deserves them. The spa is separated for men and women. To add on: everyone here tries wishes to come true, any request you have there will be at least someone trying their best to make it possible. Even if you arrive late at night, try to talk to the front desk about your possibilities, there are many more things (whisky tastings, sports club, etc.). There is a small market to get diapers, things for babies, even baby sunglasses, you could arrive with no luggage and you would find everything here. The food is another level: the selection is massive. Nobody will leave hungry. And it’s very fresh. Special thanks to the very friendly bakers! The next ATM is 5 min away by walking. Thank you Rixos! See you next year! Special thanks to Yasin, Eren, Erdem, Nathalia, Manuela, Ludi, Angelyn, Ianne, and many more people.

Питание — одно из главных достоинств. review_text:
My partner and I stayed for 8 nights in November for the first time. I’ll start with the positives we experienced during our stay.
Firstly the location is perfect, you are equally close to Yas Island or the city and can enjoy exploring both, you’re also very close to the new cultural district which has museums to explore. The beach is stunning along with the sunsets you can view.
Next the service, every staff member there is incredibly kind and helpful, from the pool to each restaurant, they can’t do enough to help.
Finally the common areas are stunning, the decor is extravagant and clearly a lot of thought has been put into it.

Now onto the negatives, if you are not a family this is not the hotel for you. It is a predominantly family friendly hotel with only one main pool.
There is a huge kids pool with slides and a wave pool that was empty during our stay, we were told by staff that this was because alcohol is not served in these areas so the parents prefer the main pool. An easy fix would be to change this rule or something more permanent would be to build an Adults only pool. There were some areas of sun loungers that were adult only but they were not poolside and they also had children there with staff not enforcing the rule.
Onto the food, we were really disappointed in the quality of food at the resort, even in the al a carte restaurants, it was fine but not in standing with the cost of the stay. The drinks on offer were generally really good, except the wine, of which there were only two option of both red and white - both of which weren’t great.
The rooms themselves looked tired, I don’t think there has been any work done to maintain the standard since opening and it showed. Paint peeling and chipped, and general wear and tear on the furniture. We stayed in the fourth floor overlooking the pool in a sea view room, at multiple points during our stay there was a smell of sewage in the hallway. One evening we returned to our room  and the smell was incredibly strong inside, I called reception immediately to report it, they called back after 20 minutes to offer us a new room on the ground floor, but at this point is was 11pm and we were tired. My parents were staying two doors down and had the same issue and the same solution was offered however again not appropriate at the time, after a while the smell started to dissipate so we were able to get to sleep. The following day management followed up with my mum (not me) and offered the same room again, however we had selected the sea view rooms for exactly that so it wasn’t an appropriate compensation, they also offered my parents a discount upon their next stay.
I work in hospitality and this was shocking to me, you should not have to pay extra in order to solve a solution that has happened during this stay. The hotel could have easily offered a complimentary gesture such as resort credit and it would have been a welcomed, particularly given the cost of the stay.
Upon checkout nothing was mentioned to me at all, no apology or acknowledgment of the issue, so I asked to speak with a Manager. I explained the problem and advised how I was really disappointed with the communication and management of the whole issue, she had no idea about it and also no idea who had been communicating with my parents, but reassured me she would fix it as they had two more days left of their stay.
Unfortunately no one reached out to them at all, and upon checking out they were informed that a ‘free’ bottle of prosecco had been placed in their room - this was incorrect, so potentially was left in the wrong room - and again this is the same prosecco that is complimentary across the resort so no real effort.
It was an incredibly disappointing end to a mostly positive stay at the Rixos, I would encourage some Incident resolution training for their management along with taking the above feedback on board.
owner_answer:
Dear Mr. Sian,

First and foremost, we would like to sincerely thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback regarding your stay with us. Every review is very important to us, and we view them as an opportunity to improve and enhance our guests’ experiences. We truly apologize for anything that may have not gone the way you expected during your visit.

We are glad to hear that you enjoyed our prime location, stunning beach, sunsets, and the level of service provided by our team. It is also wonderful to know that you appreciated the design and ambiance of our common areas.

Regarding your concerns:

Family oriented hotel  and pools: Indeed, Rixos Premium Saadiyat is a family-oriented resort, and we welcome guests of all ages. While children are present in the main pool, we also have dedicated spaces for adults, including our Spa Pool and designated adult-only areas on the beach and around the pool, where guests above 18 can enjoy a more tranquil experience.

Food and beverages: Our team strives to offer high-quality dishes prepared with the finest ingredients, and our restaurants are well-known in the region for their culinary excellence. While we have a wide selection of alcoholic beverages available, including exclusive wines available at an additional charge, we apologize if our standard wine offerings did not meet your expectations.

Room conditions and hallway smell: We are very sorry for the inconvenience caused by the temporary issue in the hallway. Our engineering team addressed the matter immediately, and we apologize for any discomfort it caused during your stay. A room move and a gesture of apology were offered at the time, and we regret if this did not fully meet your expectations. Please be assured that we continuously work to maintain and improve the quality of our rooms and facilities.

Incident resolution and communication: We sincerely apologize for any miscommunication or delay in follow-up regarding this issue. Your feedback is invaluable, and we will review our internal procedures and provide additional training to ensure such situations are handled more efficiently in the future.

We are grateful for your constructive feedback and hope that, despite the inconveniences, you were able to enjoy many aspects of your stay. It is our sincere hope to welcome you back to Rixos Premium Saadiyat, allowing us the opportunity to provide a seamless and memorable experience.

Warm regards,
Guest Relation Team

العروض والألعاب الثلجية مثل الانزلاق، تسلق الجليد، والأنفاق الثلجية تضيف عنصر الإثارة، بينما أماكن الجلوس الثلجية ومجسّمات الحيوانات تمنح لحظات جميلة للتصوير والاستمتاع بالأجواء. المكان واسع ومنظم، مما يجعل الحركة فيه سهلة ومريحة حتى مع الازدحام.

الطاقم محترف ومتعاون، ويقدّمون الإرشادات بوضوح ويهتمون بسلامة الزوار، خصوصًا الأطفال. كما أن الملابس الشتوية المتوفرة عند الدخول تزيد من راحة التجربة، وتسمح بالاستمتاع داخل المكان لفترة طويلة دون الشعور بالبرد الشديد.

النظافة ممتازة، والتنظيم رائع، والأسعار تعتبر مناسبة مقارنة بحجم التجربة وجودتها. كذلك توجد مناطق للراحة وشراء المشروبات الساخنة، مما يجعل الزيارة مكتملة وممتعة.

name: The St. Regis Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Perfect place to experience New Year fireworks in Abu Dhabi

The St. Regis Abu Dhabi is an excellent choice for celebrating New Year’s Eve, especially if you want a premium experience with great views and comfort. The hotel’s Corniche location makes it one of the best spots to enjoy the New Year fireworks without dealing with overcrowded public areas.

The overall ambiance on New Year’s Eve is elegant and festive. The fireworks view from the hotel’s venues and nearby areas is fantastic, and the atmosphere feels exclusive yet lively. Everything is well organized, from entry to seating and service, which makes the experience smooth and enjoyable.

Service, as expected from St. Regis, is top-notch — staff are attentive, professional, and make you feel well taken care of throughout the evening. The food and drinks during NYE events are high quality, with good variety and presentation.

Herşeyi ile mükemmel bir otel.
Kendine beş yıldızlı otelim diyen birçok otel St Regis i örnek almalı.
Otele giriş esnasında check in yaparken diğer bazı beş yıldızlı oteller gibi sizi ayakta bekletmiyorlar,banko önünde sıraya girmiyorsunuz.
Check in işlemlerimizi kahvemizi içerek gerçekleştirdik.
Diğer konularda zaten çok çok iyiler ama beni en çok etkileyen bu oldu.
Otele girişte,misafirine değer veren bir otel olduğunu anlıyorsunuz.
Bu resepsiyon alanını fotoğrafta da paylaşıyorum,kendine beş yıldızlıyım diyen oteller örnek alsınlar..

Kısaca otelden bahsedeyim;
Vale ler harikalar,otel personeli mükemmel,kahvaltı çok lezzetliydi ama çeşit biraz arttırılabilir.
Ayrıca kahvaltı personellerinin bazıları St Regis e göre kalitesiz gözüküyorlardı.

Onun dışında otelde alkol fiyatları çok yüksekti,daha erişilebilir olması iyi olurdu.

Geri kalan herşey mükemmeldi.
Buradan otel yönetimine teşekkür ediyorum.

The atmosphere is great and welcoming for all levels.

The food at Nalu is also really good and a perfect place to unwind after surfing.

If you’re on a tighter budget, try the Surf Social fun wave — it’s ideal for a group of friends. You still get to surf the famous wave, enjoy bites and drinks, chill by the pool, and it’s very family-friendly with a huge open space where kids can run around.

Highly recommended for a fun day with friends or family.

name: Surf Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I recently visited Surf Abu Dhabi, and it completely exceeded my expectations. From the moment we arrived, everything was perfect. The staff were friendly, professional, and genuinely passionate about surfing. The facilities are world-class, clean, and thoughtfully designed, creating the perfect environment for both beginners and experienced surfers.

The wave quality was unbelievable — consistent, powerful, and customizable to suit every level. It’s the closest thing you can get to surfing in the ocean, with the added bonus of perfect conditions every single session. The team does an amazing job keeping things safe, fun, and flowing smoothly.

A special shoutout to Grace, our surf coach, who made the whole experience even better. She was super knowledgeable, patient, and encouraging — her tips helped us improve quickly while keeping things relaxed and enjoyable. Grace’s energy and professionalism really stood out, and she made the session unforgettable.

If you’re in Abu Dhabi and love surfing (or want to learn), Surf Abu Dhabi is an absolute must-visit. I will defiently be back again to visit.

Thanks to all the team at Surf Abudabi 🙏
owner_answer: Hi Luke, thank you for your review! It was awesome having you and your crew from New Zealand with us. We’ll be sure to share your kind words with Grace and the team, they’ll be stoked to hear them. Great to know you had such an amazing experience, and we hope to see you back soon for another Surf Trip!

review_text: I can't say enough about this place. The facility is amazing , the staff is incredible and they go above and beyond to make you feel like vip customer. The second floor was a perfect place to have breakfast and watch the pool while the session was on.. Getting there , i was very nervous but the staff made me feel really relaxed and kept telling me not to worry because they would be in the water coaching me the whole time. The group in the water was awesome, everyone catching waves and having a blast . I was able to ride 8 waves and had the best time of my life. review_text:

We spent the day with a bucket of beers next to the plunge pool (helpful in the July heat) on poolside chairs with complimentary towels and a big umbrella to provide the shade. Great service both poolside/lakeside throughout the day, lovely food at the adjactent Nalu restaurant and great vibes throughout - the vibe moves from chilled to party vibes as the day progresses, with a combination of live music and a dj. A bit loud for my tastes, but I'm a middle-aged man from the UK - everything is loud!

HUGE thanks to the amazing CLAUDIO, JACOBO and GIULIA. You were/are amazing and your professionalism, as well as your friendliness and ability to engage with all types of people at the venue make it the place it is. The facilities are great (kudos to the talented folks who designed, sourced/procured and project managed such a beautiful venue) and the people...............super/amazing. Bravo!
owner_answer: Thank you, Chris! We're glad you had a brilliant day with us, even with the Uber detour. It’s great to hear you enjoyed the vibe, service, food, and especially the hospitality from Claudio, Jacobo, and Giulia—we’ll make sure to pass on your kind words. The staff were welcoming and helpful, and the entire atmosphere had a vibrant, beachside vibe right in the heart of Abu Dhabi.
It’s not just for surfers the location itself is worth visiting for meetings, inspiration, or just to take in the scene. And to top it off, they have a great restaurant on site where you can relax and enjoy a meal or coffee while watching the action. Looking forward to visiting again maybe next time with a surfboard 😉

query: The Bridge Lifestyle Hub Abu Dhabi
name: THE BRIDGE | Wellness Hub
review_text:
I couldn’t believe I’d ever write a bad review about The Bridge. I’ve been a member for almost 3 years, and my fitness journey started here. I used to love this gym — it felt like home. But now, I’m honestly heartbroken and extremely disappointed. The Bridge has changed — and not in a good way.

Let’s start with the ladies’ gym: it’s still the same tiny studio, with barely any equipment. We have one Smith machine, one shoulder machine, two back machines, and that’s it. The heaviest plate is only 15kg. I’ve requested so many times — for a leg press, hip thrust machine, abductor, back machines, and more plates. Not once did I get a reply. Every time I ask who to talk to, I’m told “Admissions doesn’t want to change anything.” So who’s actually listening to the members?

They recently added a new cardio studio, but it’s on the other side of the gym on the same floor, separated by just some curtains. It’s a very small area with maybe 4 cardio machines and 2 stair masters. That’s not enough for the number of women using the gym, and it doesn’t fix the bigger issue — the lack of proper weight training equipment.

Then there’s the ladies-only timing — from 9 AM to 12 PM on weekdays. Most of us work during those hours, and for the few who can go, it’s still not enough time. I’ve raised this point before too, and once again, nothing changes.

What frustrates me most is the renewal process. They used to offer small discounts for loyal members. This year, I got nothing — just a higher price, and now I’m paying more than double what I originally paid. And for what? The ladies’ section hasn’t improved at all. It feels like we’re being overcharged and ignored. How can prices keep going up, but the services stay the same — or worse?

I miss the old Bridge. The coaches back then were amazing — they knew us by name, brought energy to every class, and made the gym feel like a real community. Now, most of them are gone. Some of the new coaches have no energy, don’t engage with the class, and just go through the motions. Even the staff and security have changed, and it’s just not the same vibe anymore.

The Bridge keeps changing, but not for the better. All we ask for is a well-equipped ladies’ gym, proper communication, and coaches who care. I never thought I’d say this, but the gym that once felt like my second home now just feels like a business that stopped caring.

review_text:
I've been a member of UFC for three years, but over the past year, it has become increasingly difficult to attend consistently. I have already submitted a formal complaint regarding the gym equipment, yet the issues persist.
The treadmill gives electric shocks, and the stair machine randomly speeds up and slows down, making it unsafe. The yoga mats are worn out, dirty, and have an unpleasant odor. There are only two cable ropes available for around 30 people during peak hours, and just one foam bar for the entire gym. The treadmills are positioned directly in front of the mirrors, which is inconvenient. Additionally, essential equipment such as leg grips, stretch belts, and properly stored skipping ropes are missing—the skipping rope is simply thrown into an empty cardboard box.

Most concerningly, there are no water dispensers, which is surprising since this is the first gym I’ve ever been to that lacks such a basic necessity. I am extremely disappointed with the current state of the gym and the decline in its quality. To be fair enough the coaches Ayman and Hamdi are very helpful and the Receptionist is very welcoming.

review_text:
My visit to Warner Bros. World was nothing short of magical, and it is an experience I will cherish for a very long time. From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the attention to detail, the immersive atmosphere, and how every corner truly brings the world of Warner Bros. characters to life. Each area felt like stepping straight into a movie or cartoon I grew up loving, and the overall organisation and cleanliness of the park were excellent.
My favourite ride was green latern.
What truly made my visit exceptional, however, was the outstanding support and kindness of a staff member named Jennifer from Cameroon. Jennifer went above and beyond her role to ensure I had the best possible experience. She took her time to patiently explain each ride to me, making sure I fully understood what to expect before going on them. Her explanations were clear, engaging, and thoughtful, which helped me feel comfortable and excited rather than overwhelmed.
What stood out most was her deep knowledge and passion for the park. Jennifer didn’t just explain the rides; she also shared the history behind the characters and the stories that inspired each attraction. Listening to her brought the entire experience to life in a meaningful way, allowing me to appreciate the creativity and legacy of Warner Bros. on a deeper level. She answered all my questions with genuine enthusiasm and never made me feel rushed.
Jennifer’s friendly attitude and willingness to help made me feel truly welcomed and valued as a guest. It is rare to meet someone who combines excellent customer service with such sincerity and dedication, and she is truly a credit to Warner Bros. World.
Because of Jennifer, my visit was not just fun, but memorable and enriching. I left the park with a smile, wonderful memories, and a deeper appreciation.I highly recommend Warner Bros. World to anyone looking for an unforgettable experience, and I sincerely hope other visitors get the chance to be guided by someone as amazing as Jennifer. She truly made my day special.

name: Warner Bros. World™ Yas Island, Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I am a theme-park enthusiast and I’ve traveled visiting many parks and resorts all over the world.

What I found at Warner Bros World just blew me away! Although I had done my homework and studied the park in advance (reading thru the website and watching vlogging YouTube videos) I was still shocked by the high-level quality of experience this park offered!

My son and I visited on New Year’s Eve and although we were told the park would be really busy because of the holidays — it was still a very manageable experience… nothing compared to a busy day at Disneyland 🤣

The first two hours of the day were the least busiest… a good time to visit the more popular attractions (Batman: Knight Flight and Tom & Jerry’s Spin)

But throughout the day we were able to enjoy ourselves at a good and simple pace… some rides… popcorn… character interactions (…and I mean intentional interactions, not just photos!)… strolling through the park taking photos (beautiful and detailed scenery throughout the whole place)… ribeye steak lunch in Bedrock… show in the main hall area… such an amazing time.

I have to say… Warner Bros World in Abu Dhabi is one of the best! And I’ll tell you why:

1. Excellent and Friendly Employees!!! I know this should be a given when dealing with the service industry… but more and more many theme parks are beginning to lower their standards in this area. However, I found every single employee at WB World to be so absolutely friendly, helpful and excellent in their area of service. While shopping in the Bedrock Boutique, two employees: Pride and Bushra, gave me FIRST CLASS shopping experience… walking me through the store and helping me to find everything Flintstone that I wanted (I’m a huge Fred Flintstone fan!)… big friendly smiles and wonderful conversations about the local area and culture. These friendly employees really make a difference in making you feel welcomed and in having such an enjoyable day in the park!

2. Character Interactions. Not only can you meet and get a photo with the characters, but they actually take time to interact with you. For example, Robin and Batwomen took no less than 5 minutes talking to us, asking us questions, making funny jokes and just making our experience so much more fun! They were amazing! Later on, we met the Flintstones and although they can’t talk, they made motions and communicated in creative ways… again, interacting and making the whole experience so much more than just taking a photo. It’s a higher level of theming altogether. Just amazing.

3. Awesome rides and attractions! I’ve visited Warner Bros Movie World in Australia (and I love it there!) but the rides and attractions at this Warner Bros World are so much more different and highly themed. I kept telling my son “these rides are so world-class” — they could easily compete alongside anything at Disney. Creative and fun… just loved them all! My favorite was the Bedrock River Adventure, but that’s because I’m a huge Flintstones fan! Love what they did with them here… and I hope they’ll never get rid of this area. I grew up in the years when Hanna-Barbera cartoons were the main programs we watched on Saturday morning television… it’s so nostalgic to see these cartoons coming back to life here at this park. Cartoon Junction was also another favorite area with Tom & Jerry, Scooby Doo and the Looney Tunes! My son (in his twenties) really loved the Metropolis and Gotham areas and attractions in this park.

Also notable mentions for the delicious food selections and many places to sit and relax in the park. Worldclass attraction that should be visited by anyone looking to have a fun day at a theme park. Loved it so much!

My wife (52) and I (54) attended the “Old School Jam” event on 05 December 2025 and spent approximately four hours at the venue. We were initially welcomed very well, and the atmosphere at entry was pleasant.

However, this positive first impression was completely overshadowed by what followed. Over the course of the evening, we each had a few drinks — certainly no more than 10 per person. When we requested our bill upon leaving, we were shocked to be presented with a total of AED 2,000. Even more concerning, no itemized receipt was provided despite asking for one.

Without a transparent breakdown of charges, it is impossible to verify what we were actually billed for. This lack of billing transparency is unacceptable and left us feeling extremely uncomfortable and taken advantage of.

Unfortunately, this experience has completely eroded our trust in this establishment. We will not be returning and would strongly advise others to exercise caution and always insist on itemized billing before settling payment.

Very disappointed with White Club in Abu Dhabi.
Today my friends and I had an extremely unpleasant experience. We ordered specific drinks, but they brought us something completely different and, what is even more outrageous, charged us double the price for it! When we immediately said that we did not order those drinks, the waiter was incredibly rude, spoke to us arrogantly, and made no attempt to fix the issue.

The service is absolutely not what you would expect from a place that positions itself as high-end. Instead of apologizing and correcting the mistake, the staff acted as if we were at fault for placing an order at all. The atmosphere, which was supposed to be enjoyable, turned into a stressful experience — our evening was completely ruined.

I have been to many venues in Abu Dhabi, and I have never encountered such treatment towards customers. It is unacceptable to charge for something we did not order and then show such disrespect.

I do not recommend this club to anyone who values honesty, respectful service, and a pleasant experience. There are plenty of other places in the city where you can enjoy your time without this kind of negativity. White Club in Abu Dhabi is definitely not worth the money or attention.
🥲🥲🥲🤦🏻‍♀️

name: Yas Marina Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I am very disappointed with my experience at the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix. I purchased my ticket directly from the official Abu Dhabi Grand Prix website, where the description for the West Straight Grandstand clearly stated that the seats provided views of Turns 6 & 7, the starting grid, the finish line, and the podium celebrations. In reality, none of this was visible from my seat because the large 360-degree stage in front of the West Straight Grandstand completely obstructed the view towards the main straight and the podium.

Had the correct information been provided, I would have purchased a different ticket, as the advertised view was the primary reason for choosing this location. I am certain that everyone else in the same grandstand experienced the very same issue, which makes the situation even more disappointing.

I travelled from my home country specifically for this event, relying on the official information available at the time of purchase. Unfortunately, the reality did not reflect what was advertised. I attempted to resolve this matter both the day before the race and on race day by visiting the ticket office, speaking to staff, and sending multiple emails. No one offered a solution or took responsibility. The issue was moved from one department to another without any meaningful support.

For an international event of this scale, and given the cost of the ticket, the experience was extremely disappointing. We deserve accurate information and effective assistance, especially when concerns are raised early. I hope the organisers review their ticket descriptions and customer service processes so that future visitors do not face the same issue.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
We celebrated our anniversary at Zuma today and it honestly couldn’t have been a better experience. From the moment we sat down, the service and hospitality stood out just as much as the food and drinks.

A special shout-out to Kamal, our main server. He struck the perfect balance between being attentive and giving us space to enjoy our meal. He checked on us at just the right times, always had an eye on our table without hovering, and even refolded our napkins every time we left the table – those small details that really make you feel looked after. He was warm, easy to talk to, asked if we were new to Zuma and the brunch, and made us feel genuinely welcome throughout.

We also had the pleasure of being looked after by Apollo, the sommelier. He was incredibly patient, humble and kind, with a calm, warm presence that makes you want to sit and chat with him about wine all afternoon. His recommendations were spot on, and you can tell he truly enjoys what he does. He explained the wines in a simple, friendly way and was very accommodating to our preferences. Just a great person to have guiding us through the wine list.

Another special mention to Dominique. He wasn’t even serving our table, but he was one of the only team members walking past who noticed the “Happy Anniversary” message on our dessert plate and acknowledged it. As people from the hospitality industry ourselves, we really appreciate those tiny touches of awareness and genuine guest care. That simple moment of recognition says a lot about him and about Zuma’s culture. He has a spark of personality that will definitely take him a long way and adds to the Zuma brand.

The food was outstanding – we left absolutely stuffed. The quality of the produce, especially the seafood and the raw dishes, really sets Zuma apart from other high-end places. You can taste the intention and care behind every plate. The wines were excellent, and even the coffee smelled and tasted amazing.

Overall, an incredible anniversary brunch. Huge thanks to Kamal, Apollo, Dominique and the rest of the Zuma team for making our day so special. 🌟🍷🍣 Highly recommended.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Zuma never misses. Whether it’s lunch or dinner, the experience is top-tier from start to finish. I’ve been here more times than I can count and it’s consistently excellent, food, service, vibe, all on point.

The business lunch is one of the best deals in Abu Dhabi, generous portions, great variety, and perfectly executed dishes. You walk out full, satisfied, and still on schedule. For dinner, it’s a whole other level, dim lighting, smooth music, and that signature Zuma buzz that somehow makes even Tuesday feel like a Friday.

Favorites? Always the spicy beef tenderloin, black cod, sushi platter, and that dangerously good green tea banana cake. Cocktails? Sophisticated without trying too hard. Service? Polished, but human.

If I had one suggestion, maybe a couple more rotating seasonal specials or AD-exclusive dishes could keep things extra fresh for regulars like me. But honestly? Still five stars. Zuma is a benchmark for what dining in Abu Dhabi should feel like.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
We took a chance visiting Zuma on Sunday for lunch with our two kids, and the experience was truly five-star. While the reputation focuses on high-end cuisine, the atmosphere was perfectly welcoming for a family meal.
The food was, without question, excellent. The quality of the sushi and signature dishes is arguably the best in Abu Dhabi. Every single plate was executed flawlessly, arriving quickly and beautifully presented.
The service, however, truly elevates the experience. It was great: attentive but never intrusive. A special shoutout goes to Ana, our server, who made the entire lunch completely stress-free and ensured the children felt just as welcome as the adults.
Zuma proved that fine dining and family fun can absolutely coexist. We highly recommend it for a special weekend lunch.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text: 12 out of 10. The food was top-notch. Every meal we ordered was crafted in a uniquely “Zuma” way. Even something as simple as the soy beans (Edamame) was elevated beautifully. The request for a medium cook on our Wagyu was spot-on. The wine selection was amazing. The look and feel of Zuma is and always has been one of my favorites. What pushed this visit above excellence was the service. Ana Maria was amazing. Attentive, knowledgeable, and just amazing to talk to. Then there was Apollo. He went above and beyond in getting our wine to the preferred temperature. His recommendation of the Nanakanba Umeshu (Plum wine) was a definite winner! And a huge thank you to Daniel. He was amazing as the manager. I will 110% be returning. For anyone considering visiting, I highly recommend Zuma Abu Dhabi.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Zuma Abu Dhabi is absolutely amazing! Every time I visit, the experience is perfect from start to finish. The restaurant has a beautiful modern design with a warm and elegant atmosphere — perfect lighting, great music, and a lively vibe that makes it feel special the moment you walk in.

The food is incredible. Every dish is prepared with so much care and flavor — the sushi, black cod, and wagyu beef are on another level. The presentation is beautiful, and you can really taste the quality of every ingredient. Even the desserts are a work of art — the Zuma chocolate fondant is a must-try!

The staff are very professional, polite, and attentive without being too much. They always make sure everything is just right. The outdoor terrace is also stunning, especially during sunset with the beautiful Abu Dhabi skyline in view.

Yes, it’s a premium restaurant, but honestly worth every dirham for the quality, service, and atmosphere you get.

If you’re looking for the best dining experience in Abu Dhabi, I highly recommend Zuma — elegant, delicious, and unforgettable every single time.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Visited Zuma twice and I can now tell it is one of my favorite restaurant in Abu dhabi!

Love the atmosphere which blend modernity and Japanese touches.
The food is excellent, I highly recommend the seared salmon (small portions, can be shared if you order more dishes), the chawan mushi dessert (mousse and crème with bits of fresh exotic fruits) and as a mocktail the bincho gilet (Instagram worthy drink).

Also the staff was very welcoming and attentive to our needs. A big thanks to Matias who was our server and was "aux petit soins".

Hope to visit again very soon ✨
